```{r BARCODE CLEANING, include=FALSE}

# --------------------------------------------------
#  Columns that contain barcodes
# --------------------------------------------------
# "CaseReportForm_ValidBarcodePresent"  <- Ignore this column completely, it often does not line up with the others (IGNORE)
# "CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode"         <- contains correct barcode but often blank/missing in database (USE 2ND)
# "CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String"  <- most accurate and complete column, authoritative column (USE 1ST)
# "CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode"         <- contains correct barcode but often blank/missing in database (USE 3RD)
# "CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode_String"  <- contains correct barcode but often blank/missing in database (USE 4TH)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Correct Page1Barcode_String for specific export times
# ---------------------------------------------------------

paluseq_raw <- paluseq_raw %>%
  mutate(
    CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String = case_when(
      
      # Fix 1: Nub-Kara-CS02-00117 → Nub-Kara-CS01-00117
      CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String == "Nub-Kara-CS02-00117" &
        CaseReportForm_Properties_ExportTime == "3/27/2025 10:23:43 AM" ~ "Nub-Kara-CS01-00117",
      
      # Fix 2: Nub-Kara-CS02-00012 → Nub-Kara-CS02-00028
      CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String == "Nub-Kara-CS02-00012" &
        CaseReportForm_Properties_ExportTime == "3/28/2025 11:48:48 AM" ~ "Nub-Kara-CS02-00028",
      
      # Fix 3: Equ-Bole-CS04-00012 → Equ-Bole-CS04-00074
      CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String == "Equ-Bole-CS04-00012" &
        CaseReportForm_Properties_ExportTime == "4/3/2025 3:59:56 PM" ~ "Equ-Bole-CS04-00074",

      TRUE ~ CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Correct Page1Barcode_String (no export time check)
# ---------------------------------------------------------

paluseq_raw <- paluseq_raw %>%
  mutate(
    CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String = case_when(
      
      # Kon-Kmp → Kon-Kimp
      CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String == "Kon-Kmp-CS04-00121" ~ "Kon-Kimp-CS04-00121",
      
      # Nukara → Nub-Kara
      CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String == "Nukara-CS02-00098" ~ "Nub-Kara-CS02-00098",
      
      # Itu-Buni-CS03-00003 (it's an "L" should be "i")
      CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String == "ltu-Buni-CS03-00003" ~ "Itu-Buni-CS03-00003",
      
      # Itu-Buni-CS03-00011 (it's an "L" should be "i")
      CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String == "ltu-Buni-CS03-00011" ~ "Itu-Buni-CS03-00011",
      
      # Itu-Buni-CS01-00045 (it's an "L" should be "i")
      CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String == "ltu-Buni-CS01-00045" ~ "Itu-Buni-CS01-00045",
      
      # Hik-Akapo-CS04-00018 ->  Hka-Kapo-CS04-00018
      CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String == "Hik-Akapo-CS04-00018" ~ "Hka-Kapo-CS04-00018",
    
      TRUE ~ CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String
    )
  )

#Handful that say "Ltu-Buni..." fix to "Itu-Buni...", and stray quotes remaining,
paluseq_raw <- paluseq_raw %>%
  mutate(
    CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String = CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String %>%
      
      # Fix all Ltu-Buni → Itu-Buni
      gsub("^Ltu-Buni", "Itu-Buni", ., ignore.case = TRUE) %>%
      
      # Fix stray quotes
      gsub('"', "", .) %>%
      
      # Fix CSO1 / CSO2 / CSO3 / CSO4 → CS01 / CS02 / CS03 / CS04
      gsub("CSO([1-4])", "CS0\\1", ., ignore.case = TRUE) %>%
      
      # Collapse accidental double hyphens
      gsub("--+", "-", .)
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Make single barcode col using priority order above 
# ------------------------------------------------------------

paluseq_raw <- paluseq_raw %>%
  mutate(
    barcode = case_when(
      !is.na(CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String) &
        CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String != "No barcode found" ~ CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String,

      !is.na(CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode) &
        CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode != "No barcode found" ~ CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode,

      !is.na(CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode) &
        CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode != "No barcode found" ~ CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode,

      !is.na(CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode_String) &
        CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode_String != "No barcode found" ~ CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode_String,

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
#  Take a look at how [barcode] looks compared to the columns it pulled from 
# ------------------------------------------------------------
check1_barcode <- paluseq_raw %>%
  select(
    barcode,
    CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String,
    CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode,
    CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode,
    CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode_String
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Discrepant = as.logical(
      !(
        CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String == CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode &
        CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String == CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode
      )
    )
  )

#openxlsx::write.xlsx(check1_barcode, "check1_barcode.xlsx", keepNA = TRUE)


## -----------------------------------------------------
## Cleaning logic (use functions to clean common errors)
## -----------------------------------------------------

clean_barcode <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    toupper() %>%                               # normalize
    gsub("[^A-Z0-9-]", "-", .) %>%              # weird chars → hyphen
    gsub("CSO", "CS0", ., fixed = TRUE) %>%     # CSO4 → CS04
    gsub("([A-Z]{3})([A-Z]{3,4})", "\\1-\\2", .) %>%  # ensure Aaa-Bbb
    gsub("CS([0-9]{2})([0-9]{5})", "CS\\1-\\2", .) %>% # ensure CS##-#####
    gsub("-+", "-", .) %>%                      # collapse hyphens
    gsub("^-|-$", "", .)                        # trim ends
}

format_barcode <- function(x) {
  parts <- strsplit(x, "-", fixed = TRUE)
  sapply(parts, function(p) {
    if (length(p) != 4) return(NA_character_)
    province <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(p[1]))
    zone     <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(p[2]))
    cs       <- toupper(p[3])
    num      <- p[4]
    paste(province, zone, cs, num, sep = "-")
  })
}

valid_barcode_regex <- "^[A-Z][a-z]{2}-[A-Z][a-z]{2,4}-CS0[1-4]-[0-9]{5}$"


## ---------------------------
## Clean & re-format ALL barcode columns 
## ---------------------------

paluseq_raw <- paluseq_raw %>%
  mutate(
    bc_main_clean = format_barcode(clean_barcode(barcode)),
    bc_p1s_clean  = format_barcode(clean_barcode(CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String)),
    bc_p1_clean   = format_barcode(clean_barcode(CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode)),
    bc_p4_clean   = format_barcode(clean_barcode(CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode)),
    bc_p4s_clean  = format_barcode(clean_barcode(CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode_String))
  )


## ---------------------------
## Validate all cleaned versions (make sure it's in correct format)
## ---------------------------

paluseq_raw <- paluseq_raw %>%
  mutate(
    main_valid = grepl(valid_barcode_regex, bc_main_clean),
    p1s_valid  = grepl(valid_barcode_regex, bc_p1s_clean),
    p1_valid   = grepl(valid_barcode_regex, bc_p1_clean),
    p4_valid   = grepl(valid_barcode_regex, bc_p4_clean),
    p4s_valid  = grepl(valid_barcode_regex, bc_p4s_clean)
  )


## ---------------------------
## Rescue barcode from any valid column (if still errors, use a col without errors)
## ---------------------------

paluseq_raw <- paluseq_raw %>%
  mutate(
    rescue_barcode = dplyr::coalesce(
      ifelse(p1s_valid, bc_p1s_clean, NA_character_),
      ifelse(p1_valid, bc_p1_clean, NA_character_),
      ifelse(p4_valid, bc_p4_clean, NA_character_),
      ifelse(p4s_valid, bc_p4s_clean, NA_character_)
    ),
    barcode = ifelse(main_valid, bc_main_clean, rescue_barcode)
  )



## ---------------------------
## Fix stubborn barcodes manually
## ---------------------------

paluseq_raw <- paluseq_raw %>%
  mutate(barcode = case_when(
  barcode == "Hik-Akapo-CS04-00018" ~ "Hka-Kapo-CS04-00018",
  barcode == "Kin-Wng-CS02-00089" ~ "Kin-King-CS02-00089",
  barcode == "Ton-Kimp-CS03-00156" ~ "Kon-Kimp-CS03-00156",
  
  TRUE ~ barcode))

## ---------------------------
## De-duplicate: keep only latest export time
## ---------------------------

# Convert export time to POSIXct
paluseq_raw <- paluseq_raw %>%
  mutate(
    export_dt = as.POSIXct(CaseReportForm_Properties_ExportTime,
                           format = "%m/%d/%Y %I:%M:%S %p",
                           tz = "UTC")
  )

# Deduplicate by barcode
paluseq_raw <- paluseq_raw %>%
  arrange(barcode, desc(export_dt)) %>%
  distinct(barcode, .keep_all = TRUE)


## ---------------------------
## Remove helper columns
## ---------------------------

paluseq_raw <- paluseq_raw %>%
  select(-starts_with("bc_"),
         -ends_with("_valid"),
         -export_dt)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  See what still needs to be cleaned (check other cols and hardcopy CRFs on SharePoint)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

#Flag any barcode errors
check2_barcode <- paluseq_raw %>%
  select(barcode, CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String, CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode, CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode, PAGE_IMAGES) %>%
  mutate(
    site_valid = grepl("CS0[1-4]", barcode)
  )

#Drop 1 weird row w/ no barcodes or only symbols (corrected in later upload)
paluseq_raw <- paluseq_raw %>%
  filter(
    !(is.na(barcode) &
      (CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String %in% c(NA, "", "^")) &
      (CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode %in% c(NA, "", "^")) &
      (CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode %in% c(NA, "", "^")))
  )

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Remove barcodes who were not diagnosed with malaria and had no diagnosis method noted (3), investigate the 26 with NA for diagnosed**
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## CaseReportForm_VisitSection_PatientDiagnosedWithMalaria
## Responded "No" : Kin-King-CS01-00169, Kin-King-CS03-00186, Kin-King-CS03-00208

paluseq_raw <- paluseq_raw %>%
  filter(!barcode %in% c("Kin-King-CS01-00169", "Kin-King-CS03-00186", "Kin-King-CS03-00208"))

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ba-da boom ba-da bing! Now make paluseq df and make barcode first col in df 
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

paluseq <- paluseq_raw %>% 
  select(barcode, everything())



```

```{r CLEAN VISIT DATES, echo = FALSE, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}

#-----------------------------------------------------
# Create date_visit variable
#-----------------------------------------------------

paluseq <- paluseq %>% 
  mutate(
    day_visit = as.numeric(CaseReportForm_VisitSection_VisitDay),
    day_visit_flag = if_else(day_visit < 1 | day_visit > 31, "Check", "Okay"),
    
    month_visit = as.numeric(CaseReportForm_VisitSection_VisitMonth),
    month_visit_flag = if_else(month_visit < 1 | month_visit > 12, "Check", "Okay"),
    
    year_visit = as.numeric(CaseReportForm_VisitSection_VisitYear),
    year_visit_flag = if_else(year_visit %in% c(2024, 2025, 2026), "Okay", "Check"),
    
    date_visit = as.Date(CaseReportForm_VisitSection_VisitDate, format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
    
    # Flag missing/unparsed dates and dates in the future
    date_visit_flag = case_when(
      is.na(date_visit)       ~ "Check - missing",
      date_visit > Sys.Date() ~ "Check - future",
      TRUE                    ~ "Okay"
    ),
    
    # Flag where the separate day/month/year fields disagree with the date field
    date_mismatch_flag = if_else(
      is.na(make_date(year_visit, month_visit, day_visit)) |
        is.na(date_visit) |
        make_date(year_visit, month_visit, day_visit) != date_visit,
      "Check", "Okay"
    ),
    .before = 2
  )

#----------------------------------------------------------
# Date_visit variables that need to be checked (first check) 
#----------------------------------------------------------

paluseq_check_dates <- paluseq %>%
  filter(day_visit_flag == "Check" |
         month_visit_flag == "Check" |
         year_visit_flag == "Check" |
         date_visit_flag != "Okay" |
         date_mismatch_flag == "Check") %>%
  select(barcode, day_visit, day_visit_flag,
         month_visit, month_visit_flag,
         year_visit, year_visit_flag,
         date_visit, date_visit_flag, date_mismatch_flag)

# Check the new variables.
str(paluseq$day_visit)
summary(paluseq$day_visit)

  # Some implausible values
table(paluseq$day_visit_flag, useNA = 'ifany')
str(paluseq$month_visit)
summary(paluseq$month_visit)

  # Some implausible values
table(paluseq$month_visit_flag, useNA = 'ifany')
str(paluseq$year_visit)
summary(paluseq$year_visit)

  # Some implausible values
table(paluseq$year_visit_flag, useNA = 'ifany')
str(paluseq$date_visit)
summary(paluseq$date_visit)

  # Some implausible values
table(paluseq$date_visit_flag, useNA = 'ifany')
table(paluseq$date_mismatch_flag, useNA = 'ifany')

    ### ADD COMMA AT LAST LINE AND CONTIUE AS NEEDED  ......  #OPEN paluseq-dates xlsx
  
) %>%
  mutate(corrected_date_visit = as.Date(corrected_date_visit, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))

#-----------------------------------------------------
# Year-only corrections: keep month/day, impute year
#-----------------------------------------------------
# Barcodes from highlighted year_visit cells in paluseq-dates.xlsx
# orange = 2024, yellow = 2025, blue = 2026 (green already in corrections tribble)
# If a barcode is ALSO in the corrections tribble, the tribble date wins.

year_fixes <- bind_rows(
  tibble(year_fix = 2024, barcode = c(
    "Equ-Bole-CS01-00005", "Equ-Bole-CS01-00006", "Equ-Bole-CS01-00007",
    "Equ-Bole-CS01-00010", "Equ-Bole-CS02-00075", "Equ-Bole-CS03-00068",
    "Hka-Kapo-CS01-00018", "Hka-Kapo-CS01-00038", "Hka-Kapo-CS04-00004",
    "Kas-Mika-CS01-00072", "Kas-Mika-CS01-00106", "Kas-Mika-CS01-00108",
    "Kas-Mika-CS01-00123", "Kas-Mika-CS02-00059", "Kas-Mika-CS02-00062",
    "Kas-Mika-CS02-00130", "Kas-Mika-CS03-00003", "Kas-Mika-CS03-00009",
    "Kas-Mika-CS03-00038", "Kas-Mika-CS03-00041", "Kas-Mika-CS03-00080",
    "Kas-Mika-CS03-00081", "Kas-Mika-CS03-00085", "Kas-Mika-CS03-00097",
    "Kas-Mika-CS03-00101", "Kas-Mika-CS03-00119", "Kas-Mika-CS03-00120",
    "Kas-Mika-CS03-00121", "Kas-Mika-CS03-00123", "Kas-Mika-CS03-00128",
    "Kas-Mika-CS04-00001", "Kas-Mika-CS04-00032", "Kas-Mika-CS04-00091",
    "Kas-Mika-CS04-00106", "Kas-Mika-CS04-00116", "Kas-Mika-CS04-00121",
    "Kin-King-CS01-00022", "Kin-King-CS01-00056", "Kin-King-CS01-00078",
    "Kin-King-CS01-00079", "Kin-King-CS02-00014", "Kin-King-CS02-00024",
    "Kin-King-CS02-00077", "Kin-King-CS02-00106", "Kin-King-CS02-00125",
    "Kin-King-CS03-00007", "Kin-King-CS03-00008", "Kin-King-CS03-00009",
    "Kin-King-CS03-00015", "Kin-King-CS03-00041", "Kin-King-CS03-00051",
    "Kin-King-CS03-00054", "Kin-King-CS03-00063", "Kin-King-CS03-00073",
    "Kin-King-CS03-00084", "Kin-King-CS03-00102", "Kin-King-CS03-00103",
    "Kin-King-CS03-00122", "Kin-King-CS03-00125", "Kin-King-CS04-00020",
    "Kin-King-CS04-00024", "Kon-Kimp-CS01-00002", "Kon-Kimp-CS01-00014",
    "Kon-Kimp-CS01-00045", "Kon-Kimp-CS01-00054", "Kon-Kimp-CS01-00055",
    "Kon-Kimp-CS01-00085", "Kon-Kimp-CS01-00121", "Kon-Kimp-CS01-00126",
    "Kon-Kimp-CS02-00040", "Kon-Kimp-CS02-00081", "Kon-Kimp-CS03-00007",
    "Kon-Kimp-CS04-00093", "Nki-Kari-CS03-00065", "Nub-Kara-CS01-00028",
    "Nub-Kara-CS01-00080", "Nub-Kara-CS01-00081", "Nub-Kara-CS02-00001",
    "Nub-Kara-CS03-00006", "Nub-Kara-CS03-00097", "Nub-Kara-CS03-00099",

#----------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: print tribble rows for flagged barcodes not yet reviewed
#----------------------------------------------------------
# New uploads arrive weekly, so new barcodes get flagged over time.
# Run this AFTER the corrections tribble below is defined - it prints
# ready-to-paste lines to the console for anything not already listed.
# Copy the output, paste into the tribble, fill in the date from the hard copy.
#
# print_new_flags()

print_new_flags <- function() {
  new_flags <- paluseq_check_dates %>%
    filter(!barcode %in% corrections$barcode,
           !barcode %in% year_fixes$barcode)
  
  if (nrow(new_flags) == 0) {
    message("No new flagged barcodes.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  cat(sprintf('  "%s",   NA_character_,   "",   "was %s",\n',
              new_flags$barcode,
              format(new_flags$date_visit, "%m/%d/%Y")),
      sep = "")
  message("\n", nrow(new_flags), " new flagged barcodes - paste above into corrections tribble.")
}

#-----------------------------------------------------
# Integrate corrections and run flag checks again
#-----------------------------------------------------
# Only resolved rows are applied - unresolved ones have NA and fall through
# to coalesce(), leaving the original date_visit in place.

corrections_applied <- corrections %>%
  filter(!is.na(corrected_date_visit))


paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    date_visit_raw = date_visit, # keep uncorrected value for the checks below
    year_fix = year_fixes$year_fix[match(barcode, year_fixes$barcode)],
    date_visit_yearfix = make_date(year_fix,
                                   coalesce(month(date_visit), month_visit),
                                   coalesce(day(date_visit), day_visit)),
    date_visit  = coalesce(
      corrections_applied$corrected_date_visit[match(barcode, corrections_applied$barcode)], # NA where barcode not in corrections
      date_visit_yearfix,
      date_visit
    ),
    day_visit   = day(date_visit), # Recalculate day, month, year from the updated date
    month_visit = month(date_visit),
    year_visit  = year(date_visit),
    day_visit_flag   = if_else(day_visit < 1 | day_visit > 31, "Check", "Okay"),
    month_visit_flag = if_else(month_visit < 1 | month_visit > 12, "Check", "Okay"),
    year_visit_flag  = if_else(year_visit %in% c(2024, 2025, 2026), "Okay", "Check"),
    date_visit_flag  = case_when(
      is.na(date_visit)       ~ "Check - missing",
      date_visit > Sys.Date() ~ "Check - future",
      TRUE                    ~ "Okay"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-year_fix, -date_visit_yearfix)

#----------------------------------------------------------
# Date_visit variables that need to be checked (second check) 
#----------------------------------------------------------
paluseq_check_dates2 <- paluseq %>%
  filter(day_visit_flag == "Check" |
         month_visit_flag == "Check" |
         year_visit_flag == "Check" |
         date_visit_flag != "Okay") %>%
  select(barcode, date_visit, date_visit_flag,
         day_visit, day_visit_flag,
         month_visit, month_visit_flag,
         year_visit, year_visit_flag, CaseReportForm_Properties_ExportTime)

#----------------------------------------------------------
# Maintenance checks on the corrections list
#----------------------------------------------------------

# Redundant corrections: the source data has caught up and now matches ours.
# Worth retiring these - otherwise a later re-upload with a DIFFERENT date gets
# silently overridden by the old manual correction.
corrections_applied %>%
  inner_join(select(paluseq, barcode, date_visit_raw), by = "barcode") %>%
  filter(corrected_date_visit == date_visit_raw) %>%
  select(barcode, corrected_date_visit)

# Verify the corrections landed
verify_corrections <- paluseq %>%
  filter(barcode %in% corrections_applied$barcode) %>%
  select(barcode, date_visit, day_visit, month_visit, year_visit)

#-----------------------------------------------------
# Group by study periods 
#-----------------------------------------------------

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    # study start = earliest valid visit date
    date_study_start = min(date_visit, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # group by 6 months since study start
    study_period = ceiling(as.numeric(difftime(date_visit, date_study_start, units = "days")) / 182.5),
    
    #label study periods 
    study_period_2 = case_when(
      study_period %in% c(0, 1) ~ "Printemps/Spring 2024",
      study_period == 2 ~ "Automne/Fall 2024",
      study_period %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Printemps/Spring 2025",
      study_period == 5 ~ "Automne/Fall 2025",
      study_period %in% c(6, 7) ~ "Printemps/Spring 2026",
      study_period == 8 ~ "Automne/Fall 2026",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    # month-year for display
    month_year = format(date_visit, "%m-%Y")
  )

# Investigate the 8 with NA study_period 
missing_period <- paluseq %>%
  filter(is.na(study_period_2)) %>%
  arrange(study_period) %>%
  select(barcode,province, health_facility, date_visit)


# summary tables
summary(paluseq$study_period)
table(paluseq$month_year, useNA = "ifany")

#Check dates
 paluseq_date_check <- paluseq %>%
   select(barcode, date_visit, date_visit_flag, year_visit, year_visit_flag, month_visit, month_visit_flag, day_visit, day_visit_flag, CaseReportForm_VisitSection_VisitDate, CaseReportForm_Properties_ExportTime)

#write_xlsx(paluseq_date_check, "paluseq-dates.xlsx")


```

```{r fever vars, echo = FALSE, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE }

##########################################################
###       Fever cleaning and prep for table1       ###
##########################################################

# ==========================================================================
# VARIABLE MAP
# ==========================================================================
#
#   CaseReportForm_FeverSection_FeverInLast48Hours
#   -------------------------------------------------
#   "Avez-vous eu de la fievre ou des frissons au cours des dernieres 48 heures ?"
#   Have you had a fever or chills in the last 48 hours?           Oui/Non
#
#   CaseReportForm_FeverSection_DaysExperiencingFever
#   -------------------------------------------------
#   "Si oui, depuis combien de jours avez-vous eu de la fievre ou des frissons ?"
#   If yes to fever/chills in last 48h, for how many days have you had a fever or chills?   FILL-IN (days)
#
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CROSS-QUESTION LOGIC RULE
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
#   Rule: if fever_days >= 1, they logically had a fever, so
#         fever_last48hours must be Oui/Yes.
#
# Build order: fever_days first, since fever_last48hours's override depends
# on it.


# ==========================================================================
# fever_days
# ==========================================================================

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    fever_days = case_when(

      # --- Manual corrections for anomalies/NAs in database that have a value in the hardcopy ---
      barcode %in% c("Equ-Bole-CS01-00085", "Equ-Bole-CS01-00106", "Equ-Bole-CS02-00087") ~ 1,

      barcode %in% c("Nki-Kari-CS01-00095", "Kas-Mika-CS04-00015", "Kin-King-CS03-00051",
                     "Kin-King-CS03-00090", "Equ-Bole-CS01-00004", "Equ-Bole-CS01-00079",
                     "Equ-Bole-CS01-00081", "Equ-Bole-CS02-00088") ~ 2,

      barcode %in% c("Nki-Kari-CS02-00100", "Kin-King-CS03-00009", "Kin-King-CS03-00001",
                     "Kin-King-CS03-00049", "Kas-Mika-CS03-00101", "Kin-King-CS02-00028",
                     "Equ-Bole-CS02-00081") ~ 3,

      barcode %in% c("Equ-Bole-CS03-00005", "Kas-Mika-CS03-00071", "Equ-Bole-CS01-00083",
                     "Equ-Bole-CS02-00006") ~ 4,

      barcode %in% c("Hka-Kapo-CS04-00043") ~ 10,

      barcode %in% c("Kas-Mika-CS04-00092") ~ 12,

      # --- Participants who truly had no fever, so true NA because not applicable ---
      # these 6 have a 0 value for fever days but were marked "No" for fever in last 48h,
      # so they truly had no fever
      barcode %in% c("Kin-King-CS01-00006", "Kin-King-CS01-00046", "Kin-King-CS01-00142",
                     "Kin-King-CS01-00152", "Kin-King-CS02-00049", "Nub-Kara-CS01-00070") ~ NA_real_,

      # --- Else leave as is from raw variable ---
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(CaseReportForm_FeverSection_DaysExperiencingFever)
    ),

    fever_days = as.numeric(fever_days)
  )

label(paluseq$fever_days) <- "Nombre de jours avec fievre ou frissons/Number of days with fever or chills"

# Participants who had fever but days truly unknown/NA in hardcopy:
#   Equ-Bole-CS02-00096


# ==========================================================================
# fever_last48hours
# ==========================================================================

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    fever_last48hours = as.character(CaseReportForm_FeverSection_FeverInLast48Hours),

    # --- hardcode override if NA but has a value in the hardcopy form ---
    fever_last48hours = case_when(
      barcode %in% c("Hka-Kapo-CS04-00043",
                     "Hka-Kapo-CS02-00044",
                     "Itu-Buni-CS04-00074") ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ fever_last48hours
    ),

    # --- logical override: if they logically experienced fever for X days,
    #     they had fever, so change to "Yes" ---
    fever_last48hours = case_when(
      fever_last48hours %in% c("No", "No Selection") & fever_days >= 1 ~ "Yes",
      # No selection + 0 fever days: assume no fever in last 48h
      (fever_last48hours %in% "No Selection" | is.na(fever_last48hours)) & fever_days %in% 0 ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ fever_last48hours
    ),

    # --- recode to French for table1 ---
    fever_last48hours = case_when(
      fever_last48hours == "Yes" ~ "Oui/Yes",
      fever_last48hours == "No"  ~ "Non/No",
      TRUE ~ "Aucune sélection/No selection"
    ),
    fever_last48hours = factor(
      fever_last48hours,
      levels = c("Oui/Yes", "Non/No", "Aucune sélection/No selection")
    )
  )

label(paluseq$fever_last48hours) <- "Fievre ou frissons au cours des dernieres 48 heures/Fever or chills in the last 48 hours"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# fever_days_cat (optional, not currently in the table1 formula but kept
# available -- categorical bin of fever_days, for reference)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    fever_days_cat = case_when(
      # No fever / no selection -> fever days not applicable (NA)
      fever_last48hours != "Oui/Yes"     ~ NA_character_,
      # some stated having fever but did not input a number of days
      is.na(fever_days)                  ~ "Manquante/Missing",
      fever_days >= 0 & fever_days < 7   ~ "<7 jours/days",   # includes 0 = fever <1 day
      fever_days >= 7                    ~ "≥7 jours/days"
    ),
    fever_days_cat = factor(
      fever_days_cat,
      levels = c(
        "<7 jours/days",
        "≥7 jours/days",
        "Manquante/Missing"
      )
    )
  )

# Check: Non/No and No selection should be all NA; Missing only under Oui/Yes
table(paluseq$fever_last48hours, paluseq$fever_days_cat, useNA = "ifany")

label(paluseq$fever_days_cat) <- "Nombre de jours avec fievre ou frissons (categorise)/Number of days with fever or chills (categorized)"


# ==========================================================================
# QC: discrepancy check between fever_last48hours and fever_days
# ==========================================================================
# Paper-trail table: shows RAW vs CLEANED side by side, and flags discrepancies
# at both stages.
#   - Flag A: fever_last48hours = Yes, but fever_days is missing
#   - Flag B: fever_days is filled in (>=1), but fever_last48hours is No/missing
#
# raw_discrepancy_flag   -> discrepancy present in the untouched raw variables
# clean_discrepancy_flag -> discrepancy still present after cleaning
#     (should mostly be resolved by the override above, so anything showing
#      up here still needs manual review)

fever_qc <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    # --- raw values, untouched, for comparison ---
    raw_fever_last48hours = as.character(CaseReportForm_FeverSection_FeverInLast48Hours),
    raw_fever_days         = as.numeric(CaseReportForm_FeverSection_DaysExperiencingFever),

    # --- flag discrepancies in the RAW data (before any correction) ---
    raw_discrepancy_flag = case_when(
      raw_fever_last48hours == "Yes" & is.na(raw_fever_days) ~
        "Fever in last 48h = Yes, but days missing",
      raw_fever_last48hours %in% c("No", "No Selection", NA) & !is.na(raw_fever_days) & raw_fever_days >= 1 ~
        "Days filled in, but fever in last 48h = No/Missing",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # --- flag discrepancies remaining in the CLEANED data (after corrections) ---
    clean_discrepancy_flag = case_when(
      fever_last48hours == "Oui/Yes" & is.na(fever_days) ~
        "Fever in last 48h = Yes, but days missing",
      fever_last48hours %in% c("Non/No", "Aucune sélection/No selection") & !is.na(fever_days) & fever_days >= 1 ~
        "Days filled in, but fever in last 48h = No/Missing",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    barcode, date_visit, CaseReportForm_Properties_ExportTime,
    raw_fever_last48hours, fever_last48hours,
    raw_fever_days, fever_days,
    raw_discrepancy_flag, clean_discrepancy_flag
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(raw_discrepancy_flag) | !is.na(clean_discrepancy_flag))

# verify "no selection" responses are truly NA, and resolve any remaining
# clean_discrepancy_flag rows against hardcopies

#write_xlsx(fever_qc, "fever_qc.xlsx")
```

```{r CLEAN Q3. MALARIA CARE-SEEKING, echo = FALSE, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}

# ==========================================================================
# VARIABLE MAP
# ==========================================================================
#
# Q3. "Avez-vous ete traite pour le paludisme au cours des 30 derniers jours ?"
#     Treated for malaria in the last 30 days?                    Oui/Non
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatedForMalariaPast30Days
#
# 3.a "Si oui, avez-vous cherche a obtenir des conseils ou un traitement...?"
#     Sought advice/treatment from any source?                    Oui/Non
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_SoughtTreatment
#
# 3.a.1 "Si oui, ou avez-vous cherche des conseils ou un traitement
#        (cochez tout ce qui est applicable)?"                    CHECKBOX (multi)
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_Hospital              = Hopital/Hospital
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_Pharmacy              = Pharmacie/Pharmacy
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_PublicOrGovHealthCenter = Centre/poste de sante public ou gouvernemental/Public or gov. health center
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_PrivateClinic         = Clinique privee/Private clinic
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_TraditionalHealer     = Tradi-praticien/Traditional healer
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_Other                 = Autre/Other
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_OtherDetailed         = free text
#
# 3.b "Combien de jours apres le debut de la fievre ou de la maladie
#      avez-vous consulte pour la premiere fois ou recu un traitement ?"   FILL-IN (days)
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentDaysAfterSymptoms
#
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# "Autre" write-ins (treatment_location)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# treatment_location_raw is the PURE combined checkbox string -- if "Autre" was checked, its in the list literally as "Autre/Other",

# The write-in itself is in two separate columns:
#   other_responses_raw_treatmentlocation       -- untouched free text as is from the CRF
#   other_responses_corrected_treatmentlocation -- Nefer's manual interpretation of that free text
#
# CLEANED version (used for table1):
#   trt_loc_* -- one TRUE/FALSE column per option, after 2 cleaning steps:
#     Step 1: write-ins that are actually an existing option (e.g. "POSTE DE SANTE")
#             are back-coded to that option, and no longer count as Autre/Other
#     Step 2: only genuine "other" write-ins count as Autre/Other (uninterpretable text
#             like "I", "L", "AN" is dropped). A real write-in counts as
#             Autre/Other even if the box wasn't ticked.
#   treatment_location_other -- what the Autre/Other was (e.g. Infirmier/Nurse)
#   treatment_location       -- combined string of the cleaned options, e.g.
#                               "Pharmacie/Pharmacy; Autre/Other: Infirmier/Nurse"
#
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CROSS-QUESTION LOGIC RULES (skip-pattern overrides)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# These questions are administered as a skip pattern, so an answer further
# down implies what the earlier answer must have been:
#   Rule 1: 3a (sought_treatment) answered at all       -> Q3 (treated_malaria_30days) = Yes
#   Rule 2: 3a.1 (treatment_location) filled in          -> 3a (sought_treatment) = Yes
#
# Build order below is arranged so each override has what it depends on already finalized (this is why it doesn't match the 3 -> 3a -> 3a.1 -> 3b order of the questionnaire)

# ==========================================================================
# Helper: combine a set of Yes/No checkbox columns into one "checked" list
# ==========================================================================
# Returns, per row, a single string of the checked options separated by "; ", or NA if none were checked.

combine_checkboxes <- function(data, cols, labels, sep = "; ") {
  stopifnot(length(cols) == length(labels))
  checked <- sapply(cols, function(col) data[[col]] == "Yes")
  checked[is.na(checked)] <- FALSE
  apply(checked, 1, function(row) {
    if (!any(row)) return(NA_character_)
    paste(labels[row], collapse = sep)
  })
}


# ==========================================================================
# SEE RAW DATA: all Q3 variables side by side before cleaning
# ==========================================================================


malaria_care_seeking_raw <- paluseq %>%
  select(
    barcode,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatedForMalariaPast30Days,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_SoughtTreatment,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_Hospital,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_Pharmacy,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_PublicOrGovHealthCenter,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_PrivateClinic,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_TraditionalHealer,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_Other,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_OtherDetailed,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentDaysAfterSymptoms
  )


# ==========================================================================
# 3.a.1 Where treatment/advice was sought (checkbox, multi-select)
# ==========================================================================
# treatment_location_raw: pure checkbox merge -- "Autre/Other" stays as-is in  the list if checked, no correction or binning applied.
# treatment_location: cleaned version (see "Autre" write-ins note above). Built first: sought_treatment's override (below) depends on this.

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_location_raw = combine_checkboxes(
      .,
      cols = c(
        "CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_Hospital",
        "CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_Pharmacy",
        "CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_PublicOrGovHealthCenter",
        "CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_PrivateClinic",
        "CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_TraditionalHealer",
        "CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_Other"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Hopital/Hospital",
        "Pharmacie/Pharmacy",
        "Centre/poste de sante public ou gouvernemental/Public or government health center",
        "Clinique privee/Private clinic",
        "Tradi-praticien/Traditional healer",
        "Autre/Other"
      )
    ),

    # raw write-in, not cleaned
    other_responses_raw_treatmentlocation = CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_OtherDetailed,

    # manual interpretation of the write-in
    other_responses_corrected_treatmentlocation = case_when(
      barcode %in% c(
        "Equ-Bole-CS01-00228", "Hka-Kapo-CS03-00096", "Itu-Buni-CS04-00052",
        "Itu-Buni-CS04-00058", "Itu-Buni-CS04-00101", "Kin-King-CS02-00192",
        "Kin-King-CS02-00278", "Kin-King-CS03-00088", "Kin-King-CS04-00127",
        "Kin-King-CS04-00215", "Kon-Kimp-CS01-00048", "Nub-Kara-CS01-00053",
        "Tsh-Kabo-CS02-00084", "Tsh-Kabo-CS02-00122", "Tsh-Kabo-CS02-00130",
        "Tsh-Kabo-CS03-00011"
      ) ~ "À domicile ou en automédication / At home or self-medicated",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Kin-King-CS03-00022", "Kin-King-CS03-00340"
      ) ~ "Pas clair/Unclear",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Kon-Kimp-CS01-00191"
      ) ~ "Clinque ecole/School clinic",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Equ-Bole-CS01-00082", "Equ-Bole-CS01-00109", "Equ-Bole-CS01-00232",
        "Equ-Bole-CS01-00236", "Kin-King-CS04-00007", "Kin-King-CS04-00027",
        "Kin-King-CS04-00101", "Tsh-Kabo-CS02-00069", "Tsh-Kabo-CS02-00128",
        "Tsh-Kabo-CS02-00184"
      ) ~ "Infirmier/Nurse",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Kas-Mika-CS03-00130", "Kas-Mika-CS03-00259"
      ) ~ "Tradi-praticien/Traditional healer",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Equ-Bole-CS01-00212", "Kin-King-CS04-00068"
      ) ~ "Personnel médical / Medical personnel",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Nub-Kara-CS02-00021", "Nub-Kara-CS02-00045"
      ) ~ "Centre/poste de sante public ou gouvernemental/Public or government health center",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Kas-Mika-CS03-00052"
      ) ~ "Tradi-praticien/Traditional healer; Pharmacie/Pharmacy",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # --- one TRUE/FALSE column per checkbox option (raw) ---
    trt_loc_hospital    = CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_Hospital               %in% "Yes",
    trt_loc_pharmacy    = CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_Pharmacy               %in% "Yes",
    trt_loc_public      = CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_PublicOrGovHealthCenter %in% "Yes",
    trt_loc_private     = CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_PrivateClinic          %in% "Yes",
    trt_loc_traditional = CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_TraditionalHealer      %in% "Yes",
    trt_loc_other       = CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentLocation_Other                  %in% "Yes",

    # --- Cleaning step 1: write-in is actually an existing option -> back-code it ---
    trt_loc_pharmacy    = trt_loc_pharmacy    | str_detect(coalesce(other_responses_corrected_treatmentlocation, ""), "Pharmacie"),
    trt_loc_public      = trt_loc_public      | str_detect(coalesce(other_responses_corrected_treatmentlocation, ""), "Centre/poste"),
    trt_loc_traditional = trt_loc_traditional | str_detect(coalesce(other_responses_corrected_treatmentlocation, ""), "Tradi-praticien"),

    # --- Cleaning step 2: only genuine "other" write-ins count as Autre/Other ---
    treatment_location_other = case_when(
      str_detect(other_responses_corrected_treatmentlocation, "domicile")  ~ "À domicile ou en automédication/At home or self-medicated",
      str_detect(other_responses_corrected_treatmentlocation, "Infirmier") ~ "Infirmier/Nurse",
      str_detect(other_responses_corrected_treatmentlocation, "Personnel") ~ "Personnel médical/Medical personnel",
      str_detect(other_responses_corrected_treatmentlocation, "ecole")     ~ "Clinique école/School clinic",
      str_detect(other_responses_corrected_treatmentlocation, "Pas clair") ~ "Pas clair/Unclear",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # write-in was fully back-coded to an existing option in step 1
    trt_loc_backcoded_only = !is.na(other_responses_corrected_treatmentlocation) & is.na(treatment_location_other),

    # Autre/Other = genuine write-in, OR ticked Autre and write-in wasn't back-coded
    trt_loc_other = !is.na(treatment_location_other) | (trt_loc_other & !trt_loc_backcoded_only),
    # ticked Autre but write-in was blank/junk
    treatment_location_other = if_else(trt_loc_other & is.na(treatment_location_other),
                                       "Non précisé/Unspecified", treatment_location_other),

    # --- cleaned combined string, e.g. "Pharmacie/Pharmacy; Autre/Other: Infirmier/Nurse" ---
    treatment_location = str_c(
      if_else(trt_loc_hospital,    "Hopital/Hospital; ", ""),
      if_else(trt_loc_pharmacy,    "Pharmacie/Pharmacy; ", ""),
      if_else(trt_loc_public,      "Centre/poste de sante public ou gouvernemental/Public or government health center; ", ""),
      if_else(trt_loc_private,     "Clinique privee/Private clinic; ", ""),
      if_else(trt_loc_traditional, "Tradi-praticien/Traditional healer; ", ""),
      if_else(trt_loc_other,       str_c("Autre/Other: ", treatment_location_other, "; "), "")
    ) %>%
      str_remove("; $") %>%
      na_if("")
  ) %>%
  select(-trt_loc_backcoded_only)

label(paluseq$treatment_location) <- "Lieu ou le traitement a ete cherche/Where treatment was sought"


# ==========================================================================
# 3.a Sought treatment/advice from any source
# ==========================================================================

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    sought_treatment = as.character(CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_SoughtTreatment),

    # --- Manual corrections: add barcode + corrected value after hardcopy review ---
    sought_treatment = case_when(
      barcode %in% c() ~ "Yes",
      barcode %in% c() ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ sought_treatment
    ),

    # --- logical override (Rule 2): 3a.1 is only asked if 3a = Yes,
    #     so a treatment_location indicated means sought_treatment must be Yes ---
    sought_treatment = case_when(
      !is.na(treatment_location) & (is.na(sought_treatment) | sought_treatment != "Yes") ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ sought_treatment
    ),

    # --- Manual override (takes precedence over Rule 2 above): hardcopy-reviewed
  
    sought_treatment = case_when(
      barcode %in% c(
        "Kin-King-CS01-00099", "Nub-Kara-CS02-00110", "Kin-King-CS01-00053",
        "Nub-Kara-CS03-00089", "Nub-Kara-CS03-00098", "Kin-King-CS01-00051",
        "Nub-Kara-CS03-00090"
      ) ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ sought_treatment
    ),

    sought_treatment_t1 = case_when(
      sought_treatment == "Yes" ~ "Oui/Yes",
      sought_treatment == "No"  ~ "Non/No",
      TRUE ~ "Aucune selection/No selection"
    ),
    sought_treatment_t1 = factor(
      sought_treatment_t1,
      levels = c("Oui/Yes", "Non/No", "Aucune selection/No selection")
    )
  )

label(paluseq$sought_treatment_t1) <- "A cherche un traitement/Sought treatment"


# ==========================================================================
# Q3. Treated for malaria in the last 30 days
# ==========================================================================

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    treated_malaria_30days = as.character(CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatedForMalariaPast30Days),

    # --- Manual corrections: add barcode + corrected value after hardcopy review ---
    treated_malaria_30days = case_when(
      barcode %in% c() ~ "Yes",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Kin-King-CS01-00099", "Nub-Kara-CS02-00110", "Kin-King-CS01-00053",
        "Nub-Kara-CS03-00089", "Nub-Kara-CS03-00098", "Kin-King-CS01-00051",
        "Nub-Kara-CS03-00090"
      ) ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ treated_malaria_30days
    ),

    # --- logical override (Rule 1): 3a is only asked if Q3 = Yes,
    #     so any answer (Yes or No) to sought_treatment means Q3 must be Yes 
    # (sought_treatment is NA for the barcodes manually set to "No" above, since their sought_treatment was itself manually blanked out earlier 
    #  so this override correctly leaves their "No" untouched)
    treated_malaria_30days = case_when(
      !is.na(sought_treatment) & (is.na(treated_malaria_30days) | treated_malaria_30days != "Yes") ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ treated_malaria_30days
    ),

    treated_malaria_30days_t1 = case_when(
      treated_malaria_30days == "Yes" ~ "Oui/Yes",
      treated_malaria_30days == "No"  ~ "Non/No",
      TRUE ~ "Aucune selection/No selection"
    ),
    treated_malaria_30days_t1 = factor(
      treated_malaria_30days_t1,
      levels = c("Oui/Yes", "Non/No", "Aucune selection/No selection")
    )
  )

label(paluseq$treated_malaria_30days_t1) <- "Traite pour le paludisme au cours des 30 derniers jours/Treated for malaria in the last 30 days"


# ==========================================================================
# 3.b Days after symptom onset before first seeking care/treatment
# ==========================================================================

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_days_after_symptoms = case_when(
      # --- Manual corrections after hardcopy review ---
      barcode %in% c(
        "Kin-King-CS01-00099", "Nub-Kara-CS02-00110", "Kin-King-CS01-00053",
        "Nub-Kara-CS03-00089", "Nub-Kara-CS03-00098", "Kin-King-CS01-00051",
        "Nub-Kara-CS03-00090", "Kin-King-CS01-00065"
      ) ~ NA_real_,
      barcode %in% c("Kin-King-CS02-00097", "Kin-King-CS02-00127") ~ 1,
      barcode %in% c("Kon-Kimp-CS03-00003", "Kon-Kimp-CS03-00018") ~ 52,
      barcode %in% c("Kin-King-CS02-00023") ~ 6,
      # NA even though they sought treatment -- confirmed via hardcopy
      barcode %in% c("Kin-King-CS02-00027") ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatmentDaysAfterSymptoms)
    )
  )

label(paluseq$treatment_days_after_symptoms) <- "Jours apres l'apparition des symptomes avant le premier traitement/Days after symptom onset before first treatment"


# ==========================================================================
# CLEANED LOOK: Q3 variables side by side, after corrections/overrides
# ==========================================================================
# treated_malaria_30days and sought_treatment reflect Rule 1/Rule 2.
# treatment_location_raw is still the pure checkbox merge (Autre/Other kept
# treatment_location is the cleaned version.
# other_responses_raw_treatmentlocation/other_responses_corrected_treatmentlocation - raw and corrected side by side

malaria_care_seeking_2 <- paluseq %>%
  select(
    barcode,
    treated_malaria_30days,
    sought_treatment,
    treatment_location_raw,
    treatment_location,
    other_responses_raw_treatmentlocation,
    other_responses_corrected_treatmentlocation,
    treatment_days_after_symptoms
  )


# ==========================================================================
# FINAL VARIABLES (for final cleaned df and table1)
# ==========================================================================
#   treated_malaria_30days_t1
#   sought_treatment_t1
#   treatment_location                 (cleaned combined string)
#   trt_loc_hospital, trt_loc_pharmacy, trt_loc_public,
#   trt_loc_private, trt_loc_traditional, trt_loc_other   (TRUE/FALSE, for table 1 counts)
#   treatment_location_other           (Autre/Other raw before cleaning)
#   treatment_days_after_symptoms
#
# paper trail:
#   treatment_location_raw
#   other_responses_raw_treatmentlocation
#   other_responses_corrected_treatmentlocation


# ==========================================================================
# QC: discrepancy check for Rules 1 and 2
# ==========================================================================
# Paper-trail table: shows RAW vs CLEANED side by side, and flags any row
# that breaks Rule 1 or Rule 2 -- both in the raw data (before any
# correction) and, as a safety check, in the cleaned data (should always be
# resolved; a flag showing up in clean_discrepancy_flag would mean a bug in
# the logic above, not a data issue).

## Clean as of 9/24/26 check, NB ##

malaria_care_seeking_qc <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    raw_sought_treatment       = as.character(CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_SoughtTreatment),
    raw_treated_malaria_30days = as.character(CaseReportForm_MalariaBasicSection_TreatedForMalariaPast30Days),

    raw_discrepancy_flag = case_when(
      !is.na(raw_sought_treatment) & (is.na(raw_treated_malaria_30days) | raw_treated_malaria_30days != "Yes") ~
        "Rule 1: 3a (sought_treatment) answered, but Q3 (treated_malaria_30days) != Yes",
      !is.na(treatment_location_raw) & (is.na(raw_sought_treatment) | raw_sought_treatment != "Yes") ~
        "Rule 2: 3a.1 (treatment_location) given, but 3a (sought_treatment) != Yes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    clean_discrepancy_flag = case_when(
      !is.na(sought_treatment) & (is.na(treated_malaria_30days) | treated_malaria_30days != "Yes") ~
        "Rule 1: 3a (sought_treatment) answered, but Q3 (treated_malaria_30days) != Yes",
      !is.na(treatment_location) & (is.na(sought_treatment) | sought_treatment != "Yes") &
        !(barcode %in% c(
          "Kin-King-CS01-00099", "Nub-Kara-CS02-00110", "Kin-King-CS01-00053",
          "Nub-Kara-CS03-00089", "Nub-Kara-CS03-00098", "Kin-King-CS01-00051",
          "Nub-Kara-CS03-00090"
        )) ~
        "Rule 2: 3a.1 (treatment_location) given, but 3a (sought_treatment) != Yes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    barcode, date_visit, CaseReportForm_Properties_ExportTime,
    raw_sought_treatment, sought_treatment,
    raw_treated_malaria_30days, treated_malaria_30days,
    treatment_location_raw, treatment_location,
    raw_discrepancy_flag, clean_discrepancy_flag
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(raw_discrepancy_flag) | !is.na(clean_discrepancy_flag))

# NOTE: barcodes manually forced to sought_treatment = NA (Kin-King-CS01-00099, Nub-Kara-CS02-00110, Kin-King-CS01-00053, Nub-Kara-CS03-00089, Nub-Kara-CS03-00098, Kin-King-CS01-00051, Nub-Kara-CS03-00090) are EXCLUDED from the Rule 2 clean_discrepancy_flag check below, since their NA is a they'd show up  every time even though nothing is wrong.


# ==========================================================================
# treatment_location_counts -- one row per location, +1 for every
# participant who marked it, stratified by province + Total
# ==========================================================================
# Same pattern as occupation_counts: direct per-column count via
# pivot_longer(), province columns via pivot_wider(). No merged "no
# response" category here -- this question doesn't have a
# NA/DontKnow/Refused option like occupation did.
# Uses the CLEANED trt_loc_* columns (after back-coding + junk removal).


# NOTE: filtered to sought_treatment_t1 == "Oui/Yes" -- treatment_location
# (3a.1) is only meaningful for people who actually sought treatment, since it's a skip-pattern question in 3a.

treatment_location_long <- paluseq %>%
  filter(sought_treatment_t1 == "Oui/Yes") %>%
  select(
    barcode, province_desc,
    trt_loc_hospital,
    trt_loc_pharmacy,
    trt_loc_public,
    trt_loc_private,
    trt_loc_traditional,
    trt_loc_other
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(barcode, province_desc),
    names_to = "treatment_location_raw_var",
    values_to = "checked"
  ) %>%
  filter(checked) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_location_response = case_when(
      treatment_location_raw_var == "trt_loc_hospital"    ~ "Hôpital/Hospital",
      treatment_location_raw_var == "trt_loc_pharmacy"    ~ "Pharmacie/Pharmacy",
      treatment_location_raw_var == "trt_loc_public"      ~ "Centre/poste de santé public ou gouvernemental/Public or government health center",
      treatment_location_raw_var == "trt_loc_private"     ~ "Clinique privée/Private clinic",
      treatment_location_raw_var == "trt_loc_traditional" ~ "Tradi-praticien/Traditional healer",
      treatment_location_raw_var == "trt_loc_other"       ~ "Autre/Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(barcode, province_desc, treatment_location_response) %>%
  distinct(barcode, province_desc, treatment_location_response)

# denominator: number of people who marked ANY location -- used for the %
# column below, both overall and per province
n_treatment_location_respondents <- n_distinct(treatment_location_long$barcode)

n_treatment_location_respondents_by_province <- treatment_location_long %>%
  distinct(barcode, province_desc) %>%
  count(province_desc, name = "n_respondents", .drop = FALSE)

# --- counts by province, one column per province ---
counts_by_province <- treatment_location_long %>%
  count(province_desc, treatment_location_response, name = "n", .drop = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(n_treatment_location_respondents_by_province, by = "province_desc") %>%
  mutate(
    n_respondents = coalesce(n_respondents, 0L),
    pct  = ifelse(n_respondents > 0, n / n_respondents * 100, 0),
    cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct)
  ) %>%
  select(province_desc, treatment_location_response, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = province_desc, values_from = cell, values_fill = "0 (0.0%)")

# --- overall/Total column ---
counts_overall <- treatment_location_long %>%
  count(treatment_location_response, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    pct   = if (n_treatment_location_respondents > 0) n / n_treatment_location_respondents * 100 else 0,
    Total = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct)
  ) %>%
  select(treatment_location_response, n, Total)

# --- combine, order by frequency ---
treatment_location_counts <- counts_overall %>%
  left_join(counts_by_province, by = "treatment_location_response") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  rename(`Réponse/Response` = treatment_location_response)


```

```{r CLEAN Q4. MALARIA TREATMENT, echo = FALSE, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}

# ==========================================================================
# VARIABLE MAP
# ==========================================================================
#
# Q4. "Avez-vous pris, pendant les 30 derniers jours au cours de cette
#      maladie, des medicaments pour le paludisme ?"               Oui/Non
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MalariaMedicationTakenAtAnyPoint
#
# 4.a "Si oui, qu'avez-vous pris ?"                                 CHECKBOX (multi)
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_AL          = AL (artemether-lumefantrine)
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_ASAQ        = ASAQ (artesunate-amodiaquine)
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_AP          = AP (artesunate-pyronaridine)
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_DHAPQ       = DHAPQ (dihydroartemisinine-piperaquine)
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_ACT         = ACT (non specifie)
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_Quinine     = Quinine
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_SpFansidar  = SP/Fansidar
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_Paracetamol = Paracetamol
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_DontKnow    = Ne sait pas/Don't know
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_Other       = Autre/Other
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_OtherDetailed = free text
#
# 4.b "Combien de jours apres l'apparition de la fievre ou de la maladie
#      avez-vous pris le medicament pour la premiere fois ?"        FILL-IN (days)
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_FirstDoseDaysAfterFever
#
# 4.c "Avez-vous termine le traitement ?"                           Oui/Non
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_CompletedTreatment
#
# 4.c.1 "Si non, pourquoi ?"                                        CHECKBOX (multi)
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_Forgot        = Oublie/Forgot
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_SideEffects    = Effets indesirables/Side effects
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_DidNotLike     = N'a pas aime/Did not like
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_FeltBetter     = S'est senti mieux/Felt better
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_SavedForLater  = Garde pour plus tard/Saved for later
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_DidNotStart    = N'a pas commence le traitement/Did not start treatment
#     -> CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_Other          = Autre/Other
#     (no "_OtherDetailed" field exists for this checkbox group)
#
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# "Autre" write-ins (medications_taken)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# medications_taken_raw is the PURE combined checkbox string -- if
# "Autre" was checked, it stays in the list as literally "Autre/Other",
# it does NOT get replaced or folded with any interpretation of the write-in.
# The write-in itself lives in two separate columns:
#   other_responses_raw_medicationstaken       -- untouched free text, straight from the CRF
#   other_responses_corrected_medicationstaken -- your manual interpretation of that free text
#
# CLEANED version (used for table1):
#   med_* -- one TRUE/FALSE column per option, after 2 cleaning steps:
#     Step 1: write-ins that are actually an offered option (e.g. "PARACETAMOH",
#             "CARTEM"/Coartem, "ARTEMETHER") are back-coded to that option,
#             and no longer count as Autre/Other
#     Step 2: only genuine "other" write-ins count as Autre/Other. A write-in
#             with no correction (junk text, or just repeating a ticked box)
#             removes Autre/Other. A genuine write-in counts as Autre/Other
#             even if the box wasn't ticked.
#   medications_taken_other -- what the Autre/Other was (e.g. Antibiotic (Amoxicillin))
#   medications_taken       -- combined string of the cleaned options, e.g.
#                              "AL (artemether-lumefantrine); Paracetamol; Autre/Other: Antibiotic (Amoxicillin)"
#
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CROSS-QUESTION LOGIC RULES (skip-pattern overrides)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# These questions are administered as a skip pattern, so an answer further
# down implies what the earlier answer must have been:
#   Rule 3: 4c.1 (reason_not_finished_treatment) filled  -> 4c (completed_treatment) = No
#   Rule 4: 4a or 4b (medications_taken OR
#           first_dose_days_after_fever) filled          -> Q4 (malaria_medication_taken) = Yes
#
# Build order below is arranged so each override has what it depends on
# already finalized (this is why it doesn't match the Q4 -> 4a -> 4b -> 4c
# -> 4c.1 reading order of the questionnaire).


# ==========================================================================
# Helper: combine a set of Yes/No checkbox columns into one "checked" list
# ==========================================================================
# Duplicated here so this chunk is fully standalone. Returns, per row, a
# single string of the checked options separated by "; ", or NA if none
# were checked.

combine_checkboxes <- function(data, cols, labels, sep = "; ") {
  stopifnot(length(cols) == length(labels))
  checked <- sapply(cols, function(col) data[[col]] == "Yes")
  checked[is.na(checked)] <- FALSE
  apply(checked, 1, function(row) {
    if (!any(row)) return(NA_character_)
    paste(labels[row], collapse = sep)
  })
}


# ==========================================================================
# SEE RAW DATA: all Q4 variables side by side, completely untouched
# ==========================================================================


malaria_medications_raw <- paluseq %>%
  select(
    barcode,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MalariaMedicationTakenAtAnyPoint,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_AL,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_ASAQ,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_AP,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_DHAPQ,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_ACT,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_Quinine,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_SpFansidar,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_Paracetamol,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_DontKnow,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_Other,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_OtherDetailed,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_FirstDoseDaysAfterFever,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_CompletedTreatment,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_Forgot,

    medications_taken_raw = combine_checkboxes(
      .,
```
