```{r CLEAN Q4. MALARIA TREATMENT, echo = FALSE, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}
      barcode %in% c(
        "Kon-Kimp-CS03-00032"
      ) ~ "Unclear (Secours/Relief)",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Tsh-Kabo-CS03-00063"
      ) ~ "Unclear (Shalaterme)",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Kon-Kimp-CS01-00008"
      ) ~ "Unclear (Socomol)",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Kin-King-CS02-00073"
      ) ~ "Unclear (Start)",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Kas-Mika-CS01-00011"
      ) ~ "Unclear (Suharon)",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Kon-Kimp-CS02-00068"
      ) ~ "Unclear (Tisane)",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Kas-Mika-CS03-00109"
      ) ~ "Unclear (traditionnel)",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Equ-Bole-CS04-00175"
      ) ~ "Analgesic (Tramdol)",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Equ-Bole-CS01-00135"
      ) ~ "Vitamins; Unclear (Zebu)",
      barcode %in% c(
        "Nki-Kari-CS04-00194"
      ) ~ "Unclear (Zendex)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # --- one TRUE/FALSE column per checkbox option (raw) ---
    med_al          = CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_AL          %in% "Yes",
    med_asaq        = CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_ASAQ        %in% "Yes",
    med_ap          = CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_AP          %in% "Yes",
    med_dhapq       = CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_DHAPQ       %in% "Yes",
    med_act         = CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_ACT         %in% "Yes",
    med_quinine     = CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_Quinine     %in% "Yes",
    med_sp          = CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_SpFansidar  %in% "Yes",
    med_paracetamol = CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_Paracetamol %in% "Yes",
    med_dontknow    = CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_DontKnow    %in% "Yes",
    med_other       = CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MedicationsTaken_Other       %in% "Yes",

    # --- Cleaning step 1: write-in-> back-code it ---
    med_backcoded = other_responses_corrected_medicationstaken %in% c(
      "Paracetamol",
      "AL (artemether-lumefantrine)",
      "Antimalarial (Coartem)"          # Coartem = artemether-lumefantrine (CONFIRM?)
    ),
    med_paracetamol = med_paracetamol | other_responses_corrected_medicationstaken %in% "Paracetamol",
    med_al          = med_al | other_responses_corrected_medicationstaken %in% c("AL (artemether-lumefantrine)",
                                                                                 "Antimalarial (Coartem)"),

    # --- Cleaning step 2: only genuine "other" write-ins count as Autre/Other ---
    medications_taken_other = if_else(
      !is.na(other_responses_corrected_medicationstaken) & !med_backcoded,
      other_responses_corrected_medicationstaken, NA_character_
    ),
    med_other = case_when(
      !is.na(medications_taken_other)                ~ TRUE,   # genuine write-in (even if box not ticked)
      !is.na(other_responses_raw_medicationstaken)   ~ FALSE,  # write-in was junk or back-coded -> not Other
      TRUE                                           ~ med_other  # no write-in at all -> keep as ticked
    ),
    # ticked Autre with no write-in at all
    medications_taken_other = if_else(med_other & is.na(medications_taken_other),
                                      "Non précisé/Unspecified", medications_taken_other),
    
     # Don't know + any other medication -> they know something :)..., so drop Don't know 
    med_dontknow = med_dontknow & !(med_al | med_asaq | med_ap | med_dhapq | med_act |
                                      med_quinine | med_sp | med_paracetamol | med_other),

    # --- cleaned combined string ---
    medications_taken = str_c(
      if_else(med_al,          "AL (artemether-lumefantrine); ", ""),
      if_else(med_asaq,        "ASAQ (artesunate-amodiaquine); ", ""),
      if_else(med_ap,          "AP (artesunate-pyronaridine); ", ""),
      if_else(med_dhapq,       "DHAPQ (dihydroartemisinine-piperaquine); ", ""),
      if_else(med_act,         "ACT (non specifie)/ACT (unspecified); ", ""),
      if_else(med_quinine,     "Quinine; ", ""),
      if_else(med_sp,          "SP/Fansidar; ", ""),
      if_else(med_paracetamol, "Paracetamol; ", ""),
      if_else(med_dontknow,    "Ne sait pas/Don't know; ", ""),
      if_else(med_other,       str_c("Autre/Other: ", medications_taken_other, "; "), "")
    ) %>%
      str_remove("; $") %>%
      na_if("")
  ) %>%
  select(-med_backcoded)

label(paluseq$medications_taken) <- "Medicament(s) pris contre le paludisme/Malaria medication(s) taken"


# ==========================================================================
# 4.b Days after fever/illness onset before first dose
# ==========================================================================
# built here: malaria_medication_taken's override (below) depends on this

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    first_dose_days_after_fever = case_when(
      # --- Manual corrections: add barcode + corrected value after hardcopy review ---
      barcode %in% c("Nub-Kara-CS03-00091", "Nub-Kara-CS02-00079", "Nub-Kara-CS02-00127", "Nub-Kara-CS02-00128") ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_FirstDoseDaysAfterFever)
    )
  )

label(paluseq$first_dose_days_after_fever) <- "Jours apres l'apparition de la fievre avant la premiere dose/Days after fever onset before first dose"


# ==========================================================================
# Q4. Took malaria medication at any point in the last 30 days
# ==========================================================================

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    malaria_medication_taken = as.character(CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MalariaMedicationTakenAtAnyPoint),

    # --- Manual corrections: add barcode + corrected value after hardcopy review ---
    malaria_medication_taken = case_when(
      barcode %in% c() ~ "Yes",
      barcode %in% c() ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ malaria_medication_taken
    ),

    # --- logical override (Rule 4): 4a/4b are only asked if Q4 = Yes,
    #     a medication OR a first-dose-days answer on file mean Q4 must be Yes ---
    malaria_medication_taken = case_when(
      (!is.na(medications_taken) | !is.na(first_dose_days_after_fever)) &
        (is.na(malaria_medication_taken) | malaria_medication_taken != "Yes") ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ malaria_medication_taken
    ),

    malaria_medication_taken_t1 = case_when(
      malaria_medication_taken == "Yes" ~ "Oui/Yes",
      malaria_medication_taken == "No"  ~ "Non/No",
      TRUE ~ "Aucune selection/No selection"
    ),
    malaria_medication_taken_t1 = factor(
      malaria_medication_taken_t1,
      levels = c("Oui/Yes", "Non/No", "Aucune selection/No selection")
    )
  )

label(paluseq$malaria_medication_taken_t1) <- "A pris des medicaments contre le paludisme/Took malaria medication"


# ==========================================================================
# 4.c.1 Reason for not finishing treatment (checkbox, multi-select)
# ==========================================================================
# built first: completed_treatment's override (below) depends on this.
# No "_OtherDetailed" field exists for this checkbox group, so there's no write-in text 

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    reason_not_finished_treatment = combine_checkboxes(
      .,
      cols = c(
        "CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_Forgot",
        "CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_SideEffects",
        "CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_DidNotLike",
        "CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_FeltBetter",
        "CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_SavedForLater",
        "CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_DidNotStart",
        "CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_Other"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Oublie/Forgot",
        "Effets indesirables/Side effects",
        "N'a pas aime/Did not like",
        "S'est senti mieux/Felt better",
        "Garde pour plus tard/Saved for later",
        "N'a pas commence le traitement/Did not start treatment",
        "Autre/Other"
      )
    ),

    # --- Manual corrections: add barcode + corrected value after hardcopy review ---
    reason_not_finished_treatment = case_when(
      barcode %in% c() ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ reason_not_finished_treatment
    )
  )

label(paluseq$reason_not_finished_treatment) <- "Raison de ne pas avoir termine le traitement/Reason for not finishing treatment"


# ==========================================================================
# 4.c Completed treatment
# ==========================================================================

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    completed_treatment = as.character(CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_CompletedTreatment),

    # --- Manual corrections: add barcode + corrected value after hardcopy review ---
    completed_treatment = case_when(
      barcode %in% c() ~ "Yes",
      barcode %in% c() ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ completed_treatment
    ),

    # --- logical override (Rule 3): 4c.1 is only asked if 4c = No,
    #     so a reason_not_finished_treatment on file means 4c must be No ---
    completed_treatment = case_when(
      !is.na(reason_not_finished_treatment) & (is.na(completed_treatment) | completed_treatment != "No") ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ completed_treatment
    ),

    completed_treatment_t1 = case_when(
      completed_treatment == "Yes" ~ "Oui/Yes",
      completed_treatment == "No"  ~ "Non/No",
      TRUE ~ "Aucune selection/No selection"
    ),
    completed_treatment_t1 = factor(
      completed_treatment_t1,
      levels = c("Oui/Yes", "Non/No", "Aucune selection/No selection")
    )
  )

label(paluseq$completed_treatment_t1) <- "A termine le traitement/Completed treatment"


# ==========================================================================
# CLEANED LOOK: Q4 variables side by side, after corrections/overrides
# ==========================================================================
# malaria_medication_taken and completed_treatment reflect Rule 3/Rule 4.
# medications_taken_raw and reason_not_finished_treatment are the pure checkbox merges (Autre/Other kept as-is); medications_taken is the cleaned
# version. other_responses_raw_medicationstaken/ other_responses_corrected_medicationstaken side by side
malaria_medications_2 <- paluseq %>%
  select(
    barcode,
    malaria_medication_taken,
    medications_taken_raw,
    medications_taken,
    other_responses_raw_medicationstaken,
    other_responses_corrected_medicationstaken,
    first_dose_days_after_fever,
    completed_treatment,
    reason_not_finished_treatment
  )


# ==========================================================================
# FINAL VARIABLES CREATED IN THIS SECTION (for table1)
# ==========================================================================
#   malaria_medication_taken_t1
#   medications_taken            (cleaned combined string, for viewing)
#   med_al, med_asaq, med_ap, med_dhapq, med_act, med_quinine,
#   med_sp, med_paracetamol, med_dontknow, med_other   (TRUE/FALSE, for counts)
#   medications_taken_other      (what the Autre/Other was)
#   first_dose_days_after_fever
#   completed_treatment_t1
#   reason_not_finished_treatment
#
# Kept for paper trail:
#   medications_taken_raw
#   other_responses_raw_medicationstaken
#   other_responses_corrected_medicationstaken


# ==========================================================================
# QC: discrepancy check for Rules 3 and 4
# ==========================================================================
# Paper-trail table: shows RAW vs CLEANED side by side, and flags any row
# that breaks Rule 3 or Rule 4 -- both in the raw data (before any
# correction) and, as a safety check, in the cleaned data (should always be resolved; a flag showing up in clean_discrepancy_flag would mean a bug in the logic above, not a data issue).

malaria_medications_qc <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    raw_completed_treatment      = as.character(CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_CompletedTreatment),
    raw_malaria_medication_taken = as.character(CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_MalariaMedicationTakenAtAnyPoint),

    raw_discrepancy_flag = case_when(
      !is.na(reason_not_finished_treatment) & (is.na(raw_completed_treatment) | raw_completed_treatment != "No") ~
        "Rule 3: 4c.1 (reason_not_finished_treatment) given, but 4c (completed_treatment) != No",
      (!is.na(medications_taken_raw) | !is.na(first_dose_days_after_fever)) &
        (is.na(raw_malaria_medication_taken) | raw_malaria_medication_taken != "Yes") ~
        "Rule 4: 4a/4b (medications_taken/first_dose_days_after_fever) filled, but Q4 (malaria_medication_taken) != Yes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    clean_discrepancy_flag = case_when(
      !is.na(reason_not_finished_treatment) & (is.na(completed_treatment) | completed_treatment != "No") ~
        "Rule 3: 4c.1 (reason_not_finished_treatment) given, but 4c (completed_treatment) != No",
      (!is.na(medications_taken) | !is.na(first_dose_days_after_fever)) &
        (is.na(malaria_medication_taken) | malaria_medication_taken != "Yes") ~
        "Rule 4: 4a/4b (medications_taken/first_dose_days_after_fever) filled, but Q4 (malaria_medication_taken) != Yes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    barcode, date_visit, CaseReportForm_Properties_ExportTime,
    raw_completed_treatment, completed_treatment,
    reason_not_finished_treatment,
    raw_malaria_medication_taken, malaria_medication_taken,
    medications_taken_raw, medications_taken, first_dose_days_after_fever,
    raw_discrepancy_flag, clean_discrepancy_flag
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(raw_discrepancy_flag) | !is.na(clean_discrepancy_flag))

# resolve any remaining clean_discrepancy_flag rows -- these indicate a bug
# in the override logic above, not a data issue, since the overrides are
# designed to always force consistency

#write_xlsx(malaria_medications_qc, "malaria_medications_qc.xlsx")


# ==========================================================================
# medications_taken_counts -- one row per medication, +1 for every
# participant who marked it, stratified by province + Total
# ==========================================================================
# Same pattern as occupation_counts/treatment_location_counts: direct
# per-column count via pivot_longer(), province columns via
# pivot_wider(). No merged "no response" category here -- DontKnow is
# already just one of the checkbox options, not a separate NA/Refused-style
# merge like occupation had.
# Uses the CLEANED med_* columns
#
# NOTE: filtered to malaria_medication_taken_t1 == "Oui/Yes" --
# medications_taken (4a) is only meaningful for people who actually took
# medication, since it's a skip-pattern question gated on Q4.

medications_taken_long <- paluseq %>%
  filter(malaria_medication_taken_t1 == "Oui/Yes") %>%
  select(
    barcode, province_desc,
    med_al,
    med_asaq,
    med_ap,
    med_dhapq,
    med_act,
    med_quinine,
    med_sp,
    med_paracetamol,
    med_dontknow,
    med_other
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(barcode, province_desc),
    names_to = "medications_taken_raw_var",
    values_to = "checked"
  ) %>%
  filter(checked) %>%
  mutate(
    medications_taken_response = case_when(
      medications_taken_raw_var == "med_al"          ~ "AL (artéméther-luméfantrine)",
      medications_taken_raw_var == "med_asaq"        ~ "ASAQ (artésunate-amodiaquine)",
      medications_taken_raw_var == "med_ap"          ~ "AP (artésunate-pyronaridine)",
      medications_taken_raw_var == "med_dhapq"       ~ "DHAPQ (dihydroartémisinine-pipéraquine)",
      medications_taken_raw_var == "med_act"         ~ "ACT (non spécifié)/ACT (unspecified)",
      medications_taken_raw_var == "med_quinine"     ~ "Quinine",
      medications_taken_raw_var == "med_sp"          ~ "SP/Fansidar",
      medications_taken_raw_var == "med_paracetamol" ~ "Paracétamol/Paracetamol",
      medications_taken_raw_var == "med_dontknow"    ~ "Ne sait pas/Don't know",
      medications_taken_raw_var == "med_other"       ~ "Autre/Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(barcode, province_desc, medications_taken_response) %>%
  distinct(barcode, province_desc, medications_taken_response)

# denominator: number of people who marked ANY medication -- used for the %
# column below, both overall and per province
n_medications_taken_respondents <- n_distinct(medications_taken_long$barcode)

n_medications_taken_respondents_by_province <- medications_taken_long %>%
  distinct(barcode, province_desc) %>%
  count(province_desc, name = "n_respondents", .drop = FALSE)

# --- counts by province, one column per province ---
counts_by_province <- medications_taken_long %>%
  count(province_desc, medications_taken_response, name = "n", .drop = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(n_medications_taken_respondents_by_province, by = "province_desc") %>%
  mutate(
    n_respondents = coalesce(n_respondents, 0L),
    pct  = ifelse(n_respondents > 0, n / n_respondents * 100, 0),
    cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct)
  ) %>%
  select(province_desc, medications_taken_response, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = province_desc, values_from = cell, values_fill = "0 (0.0%)")

# --- overall/Total column ---
counts_overall <- medications_taken_long %>%
  count(medications_taken_response, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    pct   = if (n_medications_taken_respondents > 0) n / n_medications_taken_respondents * 100 else 0,
    Total = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct)
  ) %>%
  select(medications_taken_response, n, Total)

# --- combine, order by frequency ---
medications_taken_counts <- counts_overall %>%
  left_join(counts_by_province, by = "medications_taken_response") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  rename(`Réponse/Response` = medications_taken_response)


# ==========================================================================
# reason_not_finished_treatment_counts -- one row per reason, +1 for every
# participant who marked it, stratified by province + Total
# ==========================================================================
# Same pattern as the others so no merged "no response" category needed here.
#
# NOTE: filtered to completed_treatment_t1 == "Non/No" -- reason for not
# finishing treatment (4c.1) is only meaningful for people who did NOT
# complete treatment, since it's a skip-pattern question based on 4c.


reason_not_finished_treatment_long <- paluseq %>%
  filter(completed_treatment_t1 == "Non/No") %>%
  select(
    barcode, province_desc,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_Forgot,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_SideEffects,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_DidNotLike,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_FeltBetter,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_SavedForLater,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_DidNotStart,
    CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_Other
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(barcode, province_desc),
    names_to = "reason_raw_var",
    values_to = "checked"
  ) %>%
  filter(checked == "Yes") %>%
  mutate(
    reason_response = case_when(
      reason_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_Forgot"        ~ "Oublié/Forgot",
      reason_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_SideEffects"    ~ "Effets indésirables/Side effects",
      reason_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_DidNotLike"     ~ "N'a pas aimé/Did not like",
      reason_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_FeltBetter"     ~ "S'est senti mieux/Felt better",
      reason_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_SavedForLater"  ~ "Gardé pour plus tard/Saved for later",
      reason_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_DidNotStart"    ~ "N'a pas commencé le traitement/Did not start treatment",
      reason_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_MalariaMedicationSection_ReasonForNotFinishingTreatment_Other"          ~ "Autre/Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(barcode, province_desc, reason_response) %>%
  distinct(barcode, province_desc, reason_response)

# denominator: number of people who marked ANY reason -- used for the %
# column below, both overall and per province
n_reason_not_finished_respondents <- n_distinct(reason_not_finished_treatment_long$barcode)

n_reason_not_finished_respondents_by_province <- reason_not_finished_treatment_long %>%
  distinct(barcode, province_desc) %>%
  count(province_desc, name = "n_respondents", .drop = FALSE)

# --- counts by province, one column per province ---
counts_by_province <- reason_not_finished_treatment_long %>%
  count(province_desc, reason_response, name = "n", .drop = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(n_reason_not_finished_respondents_by_province, by = "province_desc") %>%
  mutate(
    n_respondents = coalesce(n_respondents, 0L),
    pct  = ifelse(n_respondents > 0, n / n_respondents * 100, 0),
    cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct)
  ) %>%
  select(province_desc, reason_response, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = province_desc, values_from = cell, values_fill = "0 (0.0%)")

# --- overall/Total column ---
counts_overall <- reason_not_finished_treatment_long %>%
  count(reason_response, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    pct   = if (n_reason_not_finished_respondents > 0) n / n_reason_not_finished_respondents * 100 else 0,
    Total = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct)
  ) %>%
  select(reason_response, n, Total)

# --- combine, order by frequency ---
reason_not_finished_treatment_counts <- counts_overall %>%
  left_join(counts_by_province, by = "reason_response") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  rename(`Réponse/Response` = reason_response)

# #For final cleaned df
  #        malaria_medication_taken_t1,
  #        medications_taken,
  #        med_al, med_asaq, med_ap, med_dhapq, med_act, med_quinine,
  #        med_sp, med_paracetamol, med_dontknow, med_other,
  #        medications_taken_other,
  #        first_dose_days_after_fever,
  #        completed_treatment_t1,
  #        reason_not_finished_treatment,


```

```{r CLEAN MALARIA DIAGNOSIS, echo = FALSE, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}

##########################################################
###   Diagnosis method & malaria diagnosis prep for table1   ###
##########################################################

# ==========================================================================
# VARIABLE MAP
# ==========================================================================
#
#   CaseReportForm_VisitSection_PatientDiagnosedWithMalaria   Oui/Non
#   CaseReportForm_VisitSection_DiagnosisMethod                TDRM / Microscopy / TDRM;Microscopy
#
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CROSS-QUESTION LOGIC RULE
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
#   Rule: if a diagnosis method is on file, the patient must have been
#         diagnosed with malaria -> patient_diagnosed_malaria = Oui/Yes
#
# Build order: diagnosis_method first, since patient_diagnosed_malaria's
# override depends on it.


# ==========================================================================
# Diagnosis method
# ==========================================================================

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    diagnosis_method = case_when(

      # --- Manual corrections: add barcode + corrected value after hardcopy review ---
      barcode %in% c() ~ "TDRM/RDT",
      barcode %in% c() ~ "Microscopie/Microscopy",
      barcode %in% c() ~ "TDRM/RDT & Microscopie/Microscopy",

      # --- Else, recode from raw variable ---
      CaseReportForm_VisitSection_DiagnosisMethod == "TDRM"            ~ "TDRM/RDT",
      CaseReportForm_VisitSection_DiagnosisMethod == "Microscopy"      ~ "Microscopie/Microscopy",
      CaseReportForm_VisitSection_DiagnosisMethod == "TDRM;Microscopy" ~ "TDRM/RDT & Microscopie/Microscopy",
      TRUE ~ "Aucune sélection/No selection"
    ),
    diagnosis_method = factor(
      diagnosis_method,
      levels = c(
        "TDRM/RDT",
        "Microscopie/Microscopy",
        "TDRM/RDT & Microscopie/Microscopy",
        "Aucune sélection/No selection"
      )
    )
  )

label(paluseq$diagnosis_method) <- "Méthode de diagnostic/Diagnosis method"


# ==========================================================================
# Patient diagnosed with malaria
# ==========================================================================

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    patient_diagnosed_malaria = as.character(CaseReportForm_VisitSection_PatientDiagnosedWithMalaria),

    # --- Manual corrections: add barcode + corrected value after hardcopy review ---
    patient_diagnosed_malaria = case_when(
      barcode %in% c() ~ "Yes",
      barcode %in% c() ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ patient_diagnosed_malaria
    ),

    # --- logical override: if a diagnosis method was recorded, they were
    #     diagnosed with malaria ---
    patient_diagnosed_malaria = case_when(
      diagnosis_method != "Aucune sélection/No selection" ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ patient_diagnosed_malaria
    ),

    patient_diagnosed_malaria = case_when(
      patient_diagnosed_malaria == "Yes" ~ "Oui/Yes",
      patient_diagnosed_malaria == "No"  ~ "Non/No",
      TRUE ~ "Aucune sélection/No selection"
    ),
    patient_diagnosed_malaria = factor(
      patient_diagnosed_malaria,
      levels = c("Oui/Yes", "Non/No", "Aucune sélection/No selection")
    )
  )

label(paluseq$patient_diagnosed_malaria) <- "Diagnostiqué avec le paludisme/Diagnosed with malaria"

diagnosed_check <- paluseq %>%
  select(barcode, patient_diagnosed_malaria) %>%
  filter(patient_diagnosed_malaria == "Non/No")

  select(barcode)
```

```{r CLEAN Q5. RESIDENCE ASSETS, echo = FALSE, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}
# ==========================================================================
# Helper: combine a set of Yes/No checkbox columns into one "checked" list
# ==========================================================================
# Duplicated from the malaria treatment cleaning chunk so this chunk is
# fully standalone. Returns, per row, a single string of the checked
# options separated by "; ", or NA if none were checked.

combine_checkboxes <- function(data, cols, labels, sep = "; ") {
  stopifnot(length(cols) == length(labels))
  checked <- sapply(cols, function(col) data[[col]] == "Yes")
  checked[is.na(checked)] <- FALSE
  apply(checked, 1, function(row) {
    if (!any(row)) return(NA_character_)
    paste(labels[row], collapse = sep)
  })
}
```

```{r CLEAN Q6. TRAVEL, echo = FALSE, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}
##########################################################
###   Travel (Q6) -- raw data lay of the land   ###
##########################################################

# ==========================================================================
# VARIABLE MAP 
# ==========================================================================
#
# "6. Les deplacements"
#
# 6.a "La RDC est-elle votre residence principale ?"    Main residence is DRC?   Oui/Non
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_MainResidenceDRC
#
# 6.a.1 "Si non, quel pays ?"                            Country, if not DRC     FILL-IN (text)
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_ResidenceIfNotDRC
#     *** NEEDS MANUAL REVIEW: free text, spelling variants expected ***
#
# 6.a.2 "Si non, combien de mois avez-vous passe en RDC au cours de
#        l'annee precedente ?"                          Months spent in DRC in past year
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_MonthsSpentInDRCPastYear
#     Single categorical field (NOT a multi-checkbox): <1 / 1-3 / 3-6 / >6
#
# 6.b "Avez-vous voyage en dehors de votre village/ville au cours du
#      dernier mois ?"                                  Traveled outside village/town last month?  Oui/Non
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_TraveledOutOfVillageTownPastMonth
#
# 6.b.1 "Si oui, combien de nuits avez-vous passees en dehors de votre
#        village/ville ?"                                Nights spent outside village/town (bucketed)
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_NightsSpentInLocation
#     Single categorical field (NOT a multi-checkbox): 0 / 1 / 2-3 / 4-7 / 8-14 / >14
#     *** DO NOT confuse with Location1/Location2_NightsSpentInLocation below --
#         those are a different, numeric fill-in question. ***
#
# 6.b.2 "Si oui, ou avez-vous principalement sejourne pendant votre voyage ?"
#        -- asked for up to two locations (Lieu 1 / Lieu 2)
#
#     LIEU 1:
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_Province                                          FILL-IN (text) *** NEEDS MANUAL REVIEW ***
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_Village                                            FILL-IN (text) *** NEEDS MANUAL REVIEW ***
#
#     6.b.3 "Combien de nuits avez-vous passees dans ce lieu au cours du dernier mois ?"  FILL-IN (number, NOT bucketed)
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_NightsSpentInLocation
#
#     "Motif du voyage"                                  Reason for trip     CHECKBOX (multi)
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_ReasonForTrip_Work         = Travail/Work
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_ReasonForTrip_Vacation     = Vacances/Vacation
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_ReasonForTrip_VisitFamily  = Visite a la famille/Visiting family
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_ReasonForTrip_Other        = Autre/Other  (no _OtherDetailed field in the list provided)
#
#     "Mode de transport"                                Transportation method   CHECKBOX (multi)
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_TransportationMethod_Foot        = A pied/Foot
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_TransportationMethod_Bicycle     = Bicyclette/Bicycle
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_TransportationMethod_Bus         = Bus
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_TransportationMethod_Car         = Voiture/Car
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_TransportationMethod_Motorcycle  = Moto/Motorcycle
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_TransportationMethod_Plane       = Avion/Plane
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_TransportationMethod_Ferry       = Pirogue/Dugout canoe (confirmed -- despite the variable name "Ferry", this is the raw column that captures the questionnaire's "Pirogue" checkbox)
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_TransportationMethod_Boat        = Bateau/Boat (confirmed)
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_TransportationMethod_Pirogue     = *** UNCLEAR/POSSIBLY UNUSED -- despite the variable name "Pirogue", the real Pirogue response lives in "...Ferry" above (confirmed). This column's actual meaning is unknown; check whether it ever holds data before assuming it's vestigial. ***
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_TransportationMethod_Other       = Autre/Other (no _OtherDetailed field in the list provided)
#
#     6.b.4 "Avez-vous utilise les elements suivants la ou vous avez sejourne ?"
#     Each of these 4 is its own separate Oui/Non/Ne sait pas question, with raw
#     values "Yes"/"No"/"DontKnow"/"No Selection" (confirmed) -- NOT a "check all
#     that apply" group in the raw data. That said, per your instruction, they
#     get COMBINED into one semicolon-separated list per location
#     (items_used_location1/2 below), including only the items marked "Yes" and
#     silently dropping No/DontKnow/No Selection -- combine_checkboxes() already
#     does exactly this (it only includes "Yes", everything else is excluded),
#     so it's reused here even though these aren't a true multi-select in the
#     raw CRF.
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_UsedItemsAtLocation_InsecticideTreatedMosquitoNet = Moustiquaire impregnee d'insecticide ?/Insecticide-treated mosquito net?
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_UsedItemsAtLocation_MosquitoRepellent              = Pulverisation anti-moustiques ?/Mosquito repellent spray?
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_UsedItemsAtLocation_AirConditioning                = Climatisation ?/Air conditioning?
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location1_UsedItemsAtLocation_RepellentSpray                 = Pulverisation d'insecticide ?/Insecticide spray?
#     Raw values: "Yes" / "No" / "DontKnow" / "No Selection" (confirmed).
#
#     LIEU 2 (same structure as Lieu 1, mirrored variables):
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location2_Province                                           FILL-IN (text) *** NEEDS MANUAL REVIEW ***
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location2_Village                                             FILL-IN (text) *** NEEDS MANUAL REVIEW ***
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location2_NightsSpentInLocation                                FILL-IN (number, NOT bucketed)
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location2_ReasonForTrip_Work/Vacation/VisitFamily/Other        CHECKBOX (multi), same labels as Lieu 1
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location2_TransportationMethod_Foot/Bicycle/Bus/Car/Motorcycle/
#        Plane/Ferry/Boat/Pirogue/Other                                                              CHECKBOX (multi), same labels as Lieu 1
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_Location2_UsedItemsAtLocation_InsecticideTreatedMosquitoNet/
#        MosquitoRepellent/AirConditioning/RepellentSpray                                            same as Lieu 1 -- each its OWN Oui/Non/Ne sait pas
#
#     *** CONFIRMED: no skip-pattern rule between Lieu 1 and Lieu 2 -- they are
#         cleaned independently, with no logic forcing one based on the other. ***
#
# 6.c "Avez-vous sejourne en dehors de votre province au cours des 30 derniers
#      jours (les 7 jours precedant la date de cet entretien ne comptent pas) ?"
#      Stayed outside province in the last 30 days (excluding the last 7)?   Oui/Non
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_StayedOutsideProvinceInLastMonthButNotLast7Days
#
# 6.c.1 "Si oui, quelle province ?"                      Which province           FILL-IN (text)
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_ProvinceStayedInLastMonthButNotLast7Days
#     *** NEEDS MANUAL REVIEW: free text, spelling variants expected ***
#
# 6.c.2 "Combien de nuits avez-vous passees dans ce lieu ?"     Nights spent there (bucketed)
#     -> CaseReportForm_TravelSection_NightsInLocationLastMonthButNotLast7Days
#     Single categorical field (NOT a multi-checkbox): 0 / 1 / 2-3 / 4-7 / 8-14 / >14
#

# ==========================================================================
# Helper: combine a set of Yes/No checkbox columns into one "checked" list
# ==========================================================================
# groups (ReasonForTrip_*, TransportationMethod_*) -- NOT for the
# UsedItemsAtLocation_* variables, which are 4 separate Oui/Non/Ne sait pas
# questions (raw values "Yes"/"No"/"DontKnow"/"No Selection"), not a
# multi-select checkbox group.

combine_checkboxes <- function(data, cols, labels, sep = "; ") {
  stopifnot(length(cols) == length(labels))
  checked <- sapply(cols, function(col) data[[col]] == "Yes")
  checked[is.na(checked)] <- FALSE
  apply(checked, 1, function(row) {
    if (!any(row)) return(NA_character_)
    paste(labels[row], collapse = sep)
  })
}

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(

      # --- Manual corrections: add barcode + corrected value after hardcopy review ---
      barcode %in% c() ~ NA_character_,
      CaseReportForm_TravelSection_MonthsSpentInDRCPastYear == "LessThan1"   ~ "<1 mois/<1 month",
      CaseReportForm_TravelSection_MonthsSpentInDRCPastYear == "Months1to3"  ~ "1-3 mois/1-3 months",
      CaseReportForm_TravelSection_MonthsSpentInDRCPastYear == "Months3to6"  ~ "3-6 mois/3-6 months",
      CaseReportForm_TravelSection_MonthsSpentInDRCPastYear == "Over6Months" ~ ">6 mois/>6 months",
      TRUE ~ "Aucune selection/No selection"
    ),
    months_in_drc_past_year = factor(
      months_in_drc_past_year,
      levels = c("<1 mois/<1 month", "1-3 mois/1-3 months", "3-6 mois/3-6 months",
                 ">6 mois/>6 months", "Aucune selection/No selection")

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    main_residence_drc = as.character(CaseReportForm_TravelSection_MainResidenceDRC),

    # --- Manual corrections: add barcode + corrected value after hardcopy review ---
    main_residence_drc = case_when(
      barcode %in% c() ~ "Yes",
      barcode %in% c() ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ main_residence_drc
    ),

    # --- logical override (Rule 6): 6.a.1 is only asked if 6.a = Non,
    #     so residence_if_not_drc being filled in means main_residence_drc
    #     must be No. NOT triggering on months_in_drc_past_year alone for now --
    #     if residence_if_not_drc is NA, don't override to No just yet. ---
    main_residence_drc = case_when(
      !is.na(residence_if_not_drc) &
        (is.na(main_residence_drc) | main_residence_drc != "No") ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ main_residence_drc
    ),

    main_residence_drc_t1 = case_when(
      main_residence_drc == "Yes" ~ "Oui/Yes",
      main_residence_drc == "No"  ~ "Non/No",
      TRUE ~ "Aucune selection/No selection"
    ),
    main_residence_drc_t1 = factor(
      main_residence_drc_t1,
      levels = c("Oui/Yes", "Non/No", "Aucune selection/No selection")
    )
  )

  mutate(
    nights_in_location_last_month = case_when(
      # --- Manual corrections: add barcode + corrected value after hardcopy review ---
      barcode %in% c() ~ NA_character_,
      CaseReportForm_TravelSection_NightsInLocationLastMonthButNotLast7Days == "0"      ~ "0",
      CaseReportForm_TravelSection_NightsInLocationLastMonthButNotLast7Days == "1"      ~ "1",
      CaseReportForm_TravelSection_NightsInLocationLastMonthButNotLast7Days == "2to3"   ~ "2-3",
      CaseReportForm_TravelSection_NightsInLocationLastMonthButNotLast7Days == "4to7"   ~ "4-7",
      CaseReportForm_TravelSection_NightsInLocationLastMonthButNotLast7Days == "8to14"  ~ "8-14",
      CaseReportForm_TravelSection_NightsInLocationLastMonthButNotLast7Days == "Over14" ~ ">14",
      TRUE ~ "Aucune selection/No selection"
    ),
    nights_in_location_last_month = factor(
      nights_in_location_last_month,
      levels = c("0", "1", "2-3", "4-7", "8-14", ">14", "Aucune selection/No selection")
    )
  )

label(paluseq$nights_in_location_last_month) <- "Nuits passees hors province (30j, hors 7 derniers jours)/Nights spent outside province (last 30 days, excluding last 7)"


# ==========================================================================
# 6.c Stayed outside province in the last 30 days (excluding last 7)
# ==========================================================================

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    stayed_outside_province_last_month = as.character(CaseReportForm_TravelSection_StayedOutsideProvinceInLastMonthButNotLast7Days),

    # --- Manual corrections: add barcode + corrected value after hardcopy review ---
    stayed_outside_province_last_month = case_when(
      barcode %in% c() ~ "Yes",
      barcode %in% c() ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ stayed_outside_province_last_month
    ),

    # --- logical override (Rule 8): 6.c.1/6.c.2 are only asked if 6.c = Oui,
    #     so either being filled in means stayed_outside_province_last_month
    #     must be Yes. "Aucune selection/No selection" counts as NOT
    #     answered here, same as NA. ---
    stayed_outside_province_last_month = case_when(
      (!is.na(province_stayed_last_month) |
         (!is.na(nights_in_location_last_month) & nights_in_location_last_month != "Aucune selection/No selection")) &
        (is.na(stayed_outside_province_last_month) | stayed_outside_province_last_month != "Yes") ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ stayed_outside_province_last_month
    ),

    stayed_outside_province_last_month_t1 = case_when(
      stayed_outside_province_last_month == "Yes" ~ "Oui/Yes",
      stayed_outside_province_last_month == "No"  ~ "Non/No",
      TRUE ~ "Aucune selection/No selection"
    ),
    stayed_outside_province_last_month_t1 = factor(
      stayed_outside_province_last_month_t1,
      levels = c("Oui/Yes", "Non/No", "Aucune selection/No selection")
    )
  )

label(paluseq$stayed_outside_province_last_month_t1) <- "A sejourne hors province (30j, hors 7 derniers jours)/Stayed outside province (last 30 days, excluding last 7)"


# ==========================================================================
# FINAL VARIABLES CREATED IN THIS SECTION (for table1)
# ==========================================================================
#   main_residence_drc_t1
#   months_in_drc_past_year
#   traveled_out_of_village_past_month_t1
#   nights_spent_location
#   location1_reason_for_trip
#   location1_transportation_method
#   items_used_location1
#   location1_nights
#   location2_reason_for_trip
#   location2_transportation_method
#   items_used_location2
#   location2_nights
#   stayed_outside_province_last_month_t1
#   nights_in_location_last_month
#
# Pending manual review (free text):
#   residence_if_not_drc
#   location1_province
#   location1_village
#   location2_province
#   location2_village
#   province_stayed_last_month


# ==========================================================================
# QC: discrepancy check for Rules 6, 7, and 8
# ==========================================================================

travel_qc <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    raw_main_residence_drc                 = as.character(CaseReportForm_TravelSection_MainResidenceDRC),
    raw_traveled_out_of_village_past_month = as.character(CaseReportForm_TravelSection_TraveledOutOfVillageTownPastMonth),
    raw_stayed_outside_province_last_month = as.character(CaseReportForm_TravelSection_StayedOutsideProvinceInLastMonthButNotLast7Days),

    raw_discrepancy_flag = case_when(
      !is.na(residence_if_not_drc) &
        (is.na(raw_main_residence_drc) | raw_main_residence_drc != "No") ~
        "Rule 6: 6.a.1 given, but 6.a (main_residence_drc) != No",
      ((!is.na(nights_spent_location) & nights_spent_location != "Aucune selection/No selection") |
         !is.na(location1_province) | !is.na(location1_village)) &
        (is.na(raw_traveled_out_of_village_past_month) | raw_traveled_out_of_village_past_month != "Yes") ~
        "Rule 7: 6.b.1/6.b.2 given, but 6.b (traveled_out_of_village_past_month) != Yes",
      (!is.na(province_stayed_last_month) |
         (!is.na(nights_in_location_last_month) & nights_in_location_last_month != "Aucune selection/No selection")) &
        (is.na(raw_stayed_outside_province_last_month) | raw_stayed_outside_province_last_month != "Yes") ~
        "Rule 8: 6.c.1/6.c.2 given, but 6.c (stayed_outside_province_last_month) != Yes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    clean_discrepancy_flag = case_when(
      !is.na(residence_if_not_drc) &
        (is.na(main_residence_drc) | main_residence_drc != "No") ~
        "Rule 6: 6.a.1 given, but 6.a (main_residence_drc) != No",
      ((!is.na(nights_spent_location) & nights_spent_location != "Aucune selection/No selection") |
         !is.na(location1_province) | !is.na(location1_village)) &
        (is.na(traveled_out_of_village_past_month) | traveled_out_of_village_past_month != "Yes") ~
        "Rule 7: 6.b.1/6.b.2 given, but 6.b (traveled_out_of_village_past_month) != Yes",
      (!is.na(province_stayed_last_month) |
         (!is.na(nights_in_location_last_month) & nights_in_location_last_month != "Aucune selection/No selection")) &
        (is.na(stayed_outside_province_last_month) | stayed_outside_province_last_month != "Yes") ~
        "Rule 8: 6.c.1/6.c.2 given, but 6.c (stayed_outside_province_last_month) != Yes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    barcode, date_visit, CaseReportForm_Properties_ExportTime,
    raw_main_residence_drc, main_residence_drc, residence_if_not_drc, months_in_drc_past_year,
    raw_traveled_out_of_village_past_month, traveled_out_of_village_past_month,
    nights_spent_location, location1_province, location1_village,
    raw_stayed_outside_province_last_month, stayed_outside_province_last_month,
    province_stayed_last_month, nights_in_location_last_month,
    raw_discrepancy_flag, clean_discrepancy_flag
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(raw_discrepancy_flag) | !is.na(clean_discrepancy_flag))

# resolve any remaining clean_discrepancy_flag rows -- these indicate a bug
# in the override logic above, not a data issue, since the overrides are
# designed to always force consistency

#write_xlsx(travel_qc, "travel_qc.xlsx")
```

```{r CLEAN EDUCATION VARS, echo = FALSE, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}
#Hardcode cleaning for some barcodes based on hard copies  
edu_fixes <- tibble::tribble(
  ~barcode,               ~field,                                            ~value,
  "Kin-King-CS03-00111",  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IncompleteSecondarySchool", "Yes",
  "Kin-King-CS03-00108",  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IncompletePrimarySchool",         "Yes",
  "Kin-King-CS03-00105",  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IncompletePrimarySchool",           "Yes",
  "Kas-Mika-CS03-00070",  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_OtherDetailed",           "Vocational (cultivatrice/farmer)", 
  "Nub-Kara-CS02-00079",  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_NA",           "Yes",
  "Itu-Buni-CS02-00015",  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_Doctorate",           "Yes", # "UNIVERSITE DE 7 ANS"
  "Kon-Kimp-CS01-00111",  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IncompleteSecondarySchool",           "Yes",
  "Kon-Kimp-CS01-00129",  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IncompleteSecondarySchool",           "Yes",
  "Kon-Kimp-CS01-00065",  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IncompleteSecondarySchool",           "Yes",

)

#Merge hardcoded changes back into dataset 
for(i in seq_len(nrow(edu_fixes))) {
  paluseq[[ edu_fixes$field[i] ]][ paluseq$barcode == edu_fixes$barcode[i] ] <- edu_fixes$value[i]
}

#Data is in wideformat where "Yes" is marked in the education column of participant has that level of education, but multiselection is allowed so both primary school AND high school diploma could be marked; so add ranking and take highest value as the highest education level 

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(education_firstYescol = case_when(
   CaseReportForm_EducationSection_NoFormalEducation == "Yes" ~ 0,
   CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IncompletePrimarySchool == "Yes" ~ 1,
   CaseReportForm_EducationSection_PrimarySchoolCertificate == "Yes" ~ 2,
   CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IncompleteSecondarySchool == "Yes" ~ 3,
   CaseReportForm_EducationSection_HighSchoolDiploma == "Yes" ~ 4,
   CaseReportForm_EducationSection_University3Year == "Yes" ~ 5,
   CaseReportForm_EducationSection_University5Year == "Yes" ~ 6,
   CaseReportForm_EducationSection_Doctorate == "Yes" ~ 7,
   
   CaseReportForm_EducationSection_Other == "Yes" ~ 8,
   
   CaseReportForm_EducationSection_DontKnow == "Yes" ~ 9,
   CaseReportForm_EducationSection_Refused == "Yes" ~ 10,
   CaseReportForm_EducationSection_NA == "Yes" ~ 98,
   !is.na(CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IsValidEducationSection_Note) ~ 99
  ))

#List the columns to look at when determining highest edu level (exclude other or missing/unknown)
edu_cols_main <- c(
  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_NoFormalEducation",
  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IncompletePrimarySchool",
  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_PrimarySchoolCertificate",
  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IncompleteSecondarySchool",
  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_HighSchoolDiploma",
  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_University3Year",
  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_University5Year",
  "CaseReportForm_EducationSection_Doctorate"
)

#Re-assign numeric codes
edu_map_main <- c(
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_NoFormalEducation = 0,
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IncompletePrimarySchool = 1,
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_PrimarySchoolCertificate = 2,
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IncompleteSecondarySchool = 3,
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_HighSchoolDiploma = 4,
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_University3Year = 5,
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_University5Year = 6,
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_Doctorate = 7
)
 
#1. Marks TRUE/FALSE depending on if participant answered "Yes" : [c_across(all_of(edu_cols_main)) == "Yes"] 
#2. Extracts numeric vector associated with any "Yes" : edu_map_main[edu_cols_main]
#3. Altogether, subsets the yes values and then
#4. Takes the max/highest numeric yes value and assigns that edu level to participant: education_highest_0to7 = max

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    education_highest_0to7 = max(
      edu_map_main[edu_cols_main][c_across(all_of(edu_cols_main)) == "Yes"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

### Special rules ###
# If CaseReportForm_EducationSection_NA == "Yes" , AND age_cat == "<5 Enfant/Child" THEN education must be 98/NA regardless of other marked "Yes"

CaseReportForm_EducationSection_OtherDetailed_fix = case_when(

  TRUE ~ NA
))


paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(

      # education_highest_0to7 == 6 ~ "Universite de 5 ans/Graduate-level (5‑year university)",  #COMBINED UNIVERSITY OR +
      # education_highest_0to7 == 7 ~ "Doctorat/Doctorate)",  #COMBINED UNIVERSITY OR +

      #combined missing/don't know/refused below 
      education_firstYescol %in% c(9,10,98,99) | is.na(education_firstYescol) | education_highest_0to7 == 98 | CaseReportForm_EducationSection_OtherDetailed_fix ==                                  "NA" ~ "Aucune sélection ou refusé/No selection or refused" ,
      # education_firstYescol == 9 ~ "Don't know",
      # education_firstYescol == 10 ~ "Refused", #note, 6 refused as of 3/3/2026
      # education_firstYescol == 98 ~ "NA",
      # is.na(education_firstYescol) ~ "NA",
      # education_highest_0to7 == 98 ~ "NA", 
      # CaseReportForm_EducationSection_OtherDetailed_fix == "NA" ~"NA",
      
      TRUE ~ "Check" #if no categories apply, signal a "check" to see what went wrong #no checks !
    )
  )


#see distribution
education <-paluseq %>%
  select(barcode, age_cat, date_visit, CaseReportForm_Properties_ExportTime, 
  education_cat, education_firstYescol, education_highest_0to7, 
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_NoFormalEducation,
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IncompletePrimarySchool,
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_PrimarySchoolCertificate,
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IncompleteSecondarySchool,
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_HighSchoolDiploma,

  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_Doctorate,

  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_IsValidEducationSection_Note,
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_Other,
  CaseReportForm_EducationSection_OtherDetailed,

#write_csv(education, "education.csv")

edu_order <- c(

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
```

```{r CLEAN OCCUPATION VARS, echo = FALSE, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}

##########################################################
###   Occupation -- raw data, checkbox merge, and response counts   ###
##########################################################

# ==========================================================================
# VARIABLE MAP
# ==========================================================================
#
# One raw boolean column per occupation option (checkbox, multi-select --
# most participants mark more than one,  normal for this setting), plus three special "no real answer" options and a free-text "Other":
#
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Unemployed              = Sans emploi/Unemployed
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StateEmployee            = Fonctionnaire de l'État/State employee
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_SoldierPoliceOfficer      = Militaire/Policier/Soldier/Police officer
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_PrivateCompanyEmployee    = Employé d'entreprise privée/Private company employee
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Farmer                    = Agriculteur/Farmer
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Fisherman                 = Pêcheur/Fisherman
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Driver                    = Chauffeur/Driver
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_HotelEmployee             = Employé d'hôtel/Hotel employee
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StreetSweeper             = Balayeur de rue/Street sweeper
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_MarketSeller              = Vendeur au marché/Market seller
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_BoutiqueOwner             = Propriétaire de boutique/Boutique owner
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StreetVendor              = Vendeur ambulant/Street vendor
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_MoneyChanger              = Changeur d'argent/Money changer
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Artist                    = Artiste/Artist
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Tailor                    = Tailleur/Tailor
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_SmallPersonalBusiness     = Petite entreprise personnelle/Small personal business
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Student                   = Étudiant/Student
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Other                     = Autre/Other
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_OtherDetailed             = free text
#
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_NA        = Non applicable/Not applicable
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_DontKnow  = Ne sait pas/Don't know
#   CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Refused   = Refuse de répondre/Refused


# ==========================================================================
# Helper: combine a set of Yes/No checkbox columns into one "checked" list
# ==========================================================================
# Duplicated here so this chunk is fully standalone.

combine_checkboxes <- function(data, cols, labels, sep = "; ") {
  stopifnot(length(cols) == length(labels))
  checked <- sapply(cols, function(col) data[[col]] == "Yes")
  checked[is.na(checked)] <- FALSE
  apply(checked, 1, function(row) {
    if (!any(row)) return(NA_character_)
    paste(labels[row], collapse = sep)
  })
}


# ==========================================================================
# SEE RAW DATA: all occupation variables side by side, completely untouched
# ==========================================================================

occupation_raw <- paluseq %>%
  select(
    barcode,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Unemployed,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StateEmployee,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_SoldierPoliceOfficer,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_PrivateCompanyEmployee,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Farmer,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Fisherman,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Driver,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_HotelEmployee,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StreetSweeper,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_MarketSeller,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_BoutiqueOwner,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StreetVendor,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_MoneyChanger,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Artist,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Tailor,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_SmallPersonalBusiness,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Student,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Other,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_OtherDetailed,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_NA,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_DontKnow,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Refused
  )

#write_xlsx(occupation_raw, "occupation_raw.xlsx")


# ==========================================================================
# Occupation (checkbox merge, all marked options kept) + raw/corrected
# "Autre" write-in columns
# ==========================================================================
# occupation_checkbox is still built and kept -- useful for browsing
# individual records (e.g. in a DT table later) -- just not for table1.

paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    occupation_checkbox = combine_checkboxes(
      .,
      cols = c(
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Unemployed",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StateEmployee",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_SoldierPoliceOfficer",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_PrivateCompanyEmployee",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Farmer",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Fisherman",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Driver",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_HotelEmployee",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StreetSweeper",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_MarketSeller",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_BoutiqueOwner",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StreetVendor",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_MoneyChanger",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Artist",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Tailor",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_SmallPersonalBusiness",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Student",
        "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Other"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Sans emploi/Unemployed",
        "Fonctionnaire de l'État/State employee",
        "Militaire/Policier/Soldier/Police officer",
        "Employé d'entreprise privée/Private company employee",
        "Agriculteur/Farmer",
        "Pêcheur/Fisherman",
        "Chauffeur/Driver",
        "Employé d'hôtel/Hotel employee",
        "Balayeur de rue/Street sweeper",
        "Vendeur au marché/Market seller",
        "Propriétaire de boutique/Boutique owner",
        "Vendeur ambulant/Street vendor",
        "Changeur d'argent/Money changer",
        "Artiste/Artist",
        "Tailleur/Tailor",
        "Petite entreprise personnelle/Small personal business",
        "Étudiant/Student",
        "Autre/Other"
      )
    ),

    # --- Manual corrections: add barcode + corrected value after hardcopy review ---
    occupation_checkbox = case_when(
      barcode %in% c() ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ occupation_checkbox
    ),

    # raw write-in, completely untouched
    other_responses_raw_occupation = CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_OtherDetailed,

    # manual interpretation of the write-in -- NOT folded back into
    # occupation_checkbox; kept as its own column to bin later
    other_responses_corrected_occupation = case_when(
      barcode %in% c() ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

label(paluseq$occupation_checkbox) <- "Profession/Occupation"


# ==========================================================================
# occupation_counts -- one row per response option, +1 for every participant
# who marked it (a person marking 4 options contributes to all 4 rows)
# ==========================================================================
# Straightforward pivot_longer() + count(), no helper function needed.
# NA / DontKnow / Refused are 3 separate raw columns but get merged into
# ONE response category, per your earlier instruction. distinct() below
# stops someone who marked more than one of those three from being counted
# twice in that merged row.

occupation_long <- paluseq %>%
  select(
    barcode, province_desc,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Unemployed,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StateEmployee,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_SoldierPoliceOfficer,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_PrivateCompanyEmployee,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Farmer,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Fisherman,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Driver,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_HotelEmployee,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StreetSweeper,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_MarketSeller,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_BoutiqueOwner,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StreetVendor,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_MoneyChanger,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Artist,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Tailor,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_SmallPersonalBusiness,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Student,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Other,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_NA,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_DontKnow,
    CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Refused
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(barcode, province_desc),
    names_to = "occupation_raw_var",
    values_to = "checked"
  ) %>%
  filter(checked == "Yes") %>%
  mutate(
    occupation_response = case_when(
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Unemployed"              ~ "Sans emploi/Unemployed",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StateEmployee"            ~ "Fonctionnaire de l'État/State employee",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_SoldierPoliceOfficer"     ~ "Militaire/Policier/Soldier/Police officer",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_PrivateCompanyEmployee"   ~ "Employé d'entreprise privée/Private company employee",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Farmer"                   ~ "Agriculteur/Farmer",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Fisherman"                ~ "Pêcheur/Fisherman",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Driver"                   ~ "Chauffeur/Driver",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_HotelEmployee"            ~ "Employé d'hôtel/Hotel employee",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StreetSweeper"            ~ "Balayeur de rue/Street sweeper",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_MarketSeller"             ~ "Vendeur au marché/Market seller",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_BoutiqueOwner"            ~ "Propriétaire de boutique/Boutique owner",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StreetVendor"             ~ "Vendeur ambulant/Street vendor",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_MoneyChanger"             ~ "Changeur d'argent/Money changer",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Artist"                   ~ "Artiste/Artist",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Tailor"                   ~ "Tailleur/Tailor",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_SmallPersonalBusiness"    ~ "Petite entreprise personnelle/Small personal business",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Student"                  ~ "Étudiant/Student",
      occupation_raw_var == "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Other"                    ~ "Autre/Other",
      occupation_raw_var %in% c("CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_NA",
                                 "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_DontKnow",
                                 "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Refused") ~
        "Refusé, ne sait pas, ou aucune sélection/Refused, don't know, or no selection",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(barcode, province_desc, occupation_response) %>%
  distinct(barcode, province_desc, occupation_response)

# denominator: number of people who marked ANYTHING at all (an occupation,
# or NA/DontKnow/Refused) -- used for the % column below. Computed both
# overall and per province, since % should be "of respondents in that
# province," not "of the full study N."
n_occupation_respondents <- n_distinct(occupation_long$barcode)

n_occupation_respondents_by_province <- occupation_long %>%
  distinct(barcode, province_desc) %>%
  count(province_desc, name = "n_respondents", .drop = FALSE)

# --- counts by province, one column per province ---
counts_by_province <- occupation_long %>%
  count(province_desc, occupation_response, name = "n", .drop = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(n_occupation_respondents_by_province, by = "province_desc") %>%
  mutate(
    n_respondents = coalesce(n_respondents, 0L),
    pct  = ifelse(n_respondents > 0, n / n_respondents * 100, 0),
    cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct)
  ) %>%
  select(province_desc, occupation_response, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = province_desc, values_from = cell, values_fill = "0 (0.0%)")

# --- overall/Total column ---
counts_overall <- occupation_long %>%
  count(occupation_response, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    pct   = if (n_occupation_respondents > 0) n / n_occupation_respondents * 100 else 0,
    Total = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct)
  ) %>%
  select(occupation_response, n, Total)

# --- combine, order by frequency, force the merged row last ---
occupation_counts <- counts_overall %>%
  left_join(counts_by_province, by = "occupation_response") %>%
  mutate(
    .force_last = occupation_response == "Refusé, ne sait pas, ou aucune sélection/Refused, don't know, or no selection"
  ) %>%
  arrange(.force_last, desc(n)) %>%
  select(-n, -.force_last) %>%
  rename(`Réponse/Response` = occupation_response)

# occupation_counts %>% kable(align = "l") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
#   footnote(general = paste0("N = ", n_occupation_respondents, " ont répondu à cette question/responded to this question. Réponses multiples possibles, les pourcentages ne totalisent pas 100%/Multiple responses possible, percentages do not sum to 100%."))


# ==========================================================================
# occupation_df -- same numbers, built a completely different way as a
# cross-check: treat each occupation as its own raw column, count how many
# participants have "Yes" in that column directly. No pivoting to long
# format, no separate_rows -- just counting each column on its own. Each
# individual occupation's count can never exceed the total number of
# participants (barcode), since one column only has one Yes/No per person.
# ==========================================================================

occupation_cols <- c(
  Unemployed             = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Unemployed",
  StateEmployee          = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StateEmployee",
  SoldierPoliceOfficer   = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_SoldierPoliceOfficer",
  PrivateCompanyEmployee = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_PrivateCompanyEmployee",
  Farmer                 = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Farmer",
  Fisherman              = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Fisherman",
  Driver                 = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Driver",
  HotelEmployee          = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_HotelEmployee",
  StreetSweeper          = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StreetSweeper",
  MarketSeller           = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_MarketSeller",
  BoutiqueOwner          = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_BoutiqueOwner",
  StreetVendor           = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_StreetVendor",
  MoneyChanger           = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_MoneyChanger",
  Artist                 = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Artist",
  Tailor                 = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Tailor",
  SmallPersonalBusiness  = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_SmallPersonalBusiness",
  Student                = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Student",
  Other                  = "CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Other"
)

occupation_labels <- c(
  Unemployed             = "Sans emploi/Unemployed",
  StateEmployee          = "Fonctionnaire de l'État/State employee",
  SoldierPoliceOfficer   = "Militaire/Policier/Soldier/Police officer",
  PrivateCompanyEmployee = "Employé d'entreprise privée/Private company employee",
  Farmer                 = "Agriculteur/Farmer",
  Fisherman              = "Pêcheur/Fisherman",
  Driver                 = "Chauffeur/Driver",
  HotelEmployee          = "Employé d'hôtel/Hotel employee",
  StreetSweeper          = "Balayeur de rue/Street sweeper",
  MarketSeller           = "Vendeur au marché/Market seller",
  BoutiqueOwner          = "Propriétaire de boutique/Boutique owner",
  StreetVendor           = "Vendeur ambulant/Street vendor",
  MoneyChanger           = "Changeur d'argent/Money changer",
  Artist                 = "Artiste/Artist",
  Tailor                 = "Tailleur/Tailor",
  SmallPersonalBusiness  = "Petite entreprise personnelle/Small personal business",
  Student                = "Étudiant/Student",
  Other                  = "Autre/Other"
)

# one column per occupation, TRUE/FALSE for whether that participant marked
# it -- this is the literal "make each checkbox item a column, give them a
# Yes for that" step. unname() here is important -- without it, select()
# renames these columns to the short labels (Unemployed, StateEmployee...)
# as a side effect of using a named vector, which breaks the lookup below.
occupation_yes_flags <- paluseq %>%
  select(barcode, all_of(unname(occupation_cols)))

# count the Yes's in each column, one at a time
occupation_df <- tibble(
  occupation_response = unname(occupation_labels[names(occupation_cols)]),
  n_participants = sapply(occupation_cols, function(col) {
    sum(occupation_yes_flags[[col]] == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  })
)

# NA / DontKnow / Refused merged into one row -- counted as "marked at
# least one of the three" per participant (not simply added together,
# which would double-count anyone who somehow marked more than one)
occupation_no_response_flag <- paluseq %>%
  transmute(
    barcode,
    marked_no_response = (CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_NA == "Yes") |
                          (CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_DontKnow == "Yes") |
                          (CaseReportForm_OccupationSection_Refused == "Yes")
  )

occupation_df <- occupation_df %>%
  add_row(
    occupation_response = "Refusé, ne sait pas, ou aucune sélection/Refused, don't know, or no selection",
    n_participants = sum(occupation_no_response_flag$marked_no_response, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = n_participants / n_occupation_respondents * 100,
    `n (%)` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n_participants, pct),
    .force_last = occupation_response == "Refusé, ne sait pas, ou aucune sélection/Refused, don't know, or no selection"
  ) %>%
  arrange(.force_last, desc(n_participants)) %>%
  select(`Réponse/Response` = occupation_response, `n (%)`)



```

```{r cleanbars and consent, echo = FALSE, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}

############################################################################
#Read in paquet_scanner data 
#(non-consented barcodes where data has already been uploaded to the database)
###############################################################################

noconsent_Equ_Bole <- read_excel("paquet_scanner/Paquet_scanner Equateur-Bolenge.xlsx", sheet = "Removed-Samples", col_names = FALSE) #4
noconsent_Hka_Kapo <- read_excel("paquet_scanner/Paquet_scanner Haut Katanga-Kapolowe.xlsx", sheet = "Removed-samples", col_names = FALSE) #14
noconsent_Itu_Buni <- read_excel("paquet_scanner/Paquet_scanner Ituri-Bunia.xlsx", sheet = "Samples removed", col_names = FALSE) #2
noconsent_Kas_Mika <- read_excel("paquet_scanner/Paquet_scanner Kaisai Central-Mikalayi.xlsx", sheet = "Removed-samples", col_names = FALSE) #24
noconsent_Kon_Kimp <- read_excel("paquet_scanner/Paquet_scanner Kongo Central-Kimpese.xlsx", sheet = "Samples removed", col_names = FALSE) #49
noconsent_Kin_King <- read_excel("paquet_scanner/Paquet_scanner Kinshasa-Kingasani.xlsx", sheet = "Removed-Samples", col_names = FALSE) #13
noconsent_Nki_Kari <- read_excel("paquet_scanner/Paquet_scanner Nord Kivu-Karisimbi.xlsx", sheet = "Samples removed", col_names = FALSE) #85
noconsent_Nub_Kara <- read_excel("paquet_scanner/Paquet_scanner Nord Ubangi-Karawa.xlsx", sheet = "Removed-Samples", col_names = FALSE) #13
#noconsent_Tsh_Kabo <- read_excel("paquet_scanner/Paquet_scanner Tshopo-Kabondo.xlsx") #no non-consented 


# 2. Put them into a named list
noconsent_list <- list(
  Equ_Bole   = noconsent_Equ_Bole,
  Itu_Buni  = noconsent_Itu_Buni,
  Hka_Kapo  = noconsent_Hka_Kapo,
  Nub_Kara  = noconsent_Nub_Kara,
  Nki_Kari = noconsent_Nki_Kari,
  Kin_King = noconsent_Kin_King,
  Kon_Kimp  = noconsent_Kon_Kimp,
  Kas_Mika  = noconsent_Kas_Mika
  
)

# 3. Combine all barcodes into one dataframe
#   keep only the barcode column
#   remove timestamps
#   note source
#   ignore case
all_noconsent <- map_df(
  names(noconsent_list),
  ~ noconsent_list[[.x]] %>%
      mutate(source = .x) %>%
      rename(raw_barcode = 1) %>%              # first column is barcode+timestamp
      mutate(
        barcode = str_extract(raw_barcode, "[A-Za-z0-9-]+$"),  # keep only the barcode part
        barcode = str_to_upper(barcode)                       # normalize case
      ) %>%
      select(barcode, source)
)

# 4. Normalize paluseq barcodes to uppercase for case-insensitive matching
paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(barcode_upper = str_to_upper(barcode))

# 5. Match barcodes from combined noconsent sheets to see if exists in paluseq$barcode (upper case) TRUE/FALSE
all_noconsent <- all_noconsent %>%
  mutate(
    in_paluseq = barcode %in% paluseq$barcode_upper 
  )

#write_xlsx(all_noconsent, "all_noconsent.xlsx")

#################################
# QC non consent table
##########################

# 1. Identify unique barcodes that appear in paluseq (NOT CONSENTED)
barcodes_to_remove <- all_noconsent %>%
  filter(in_paluseq) %>%
  distinct(barcode) %>%        # ensure uniqueness
  pull(barcode)

# 2. QC by site (unique barcodes only)
qc_by_site <- all_noconsent %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(
    total_in_sheet = n_distinct(barcode),                 # unique barcodes per sheet
    not_consented = n_distinct(barcode[in_paluseq]),      # unique matches in paluseq
    consented = total_in_sheet - not_consented            # unique non-matches
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(not_consented))

# 3. Remove NOT CONSENTED barcodes from paluseq
paluseq_clean <- paluseq %>%
  filter(!barcode_upper %in% barcodes_to_remove)

# 4. Compute actual removal counts
qc_overall <- tibble(
  metric = c("paluseq original rows",
             "unique NOT CONSENTED barcodes (to remove)",
             "rows actually removed from paluseq",
             "paluseq rows after removal"),
  value = c(
    nrow(paluseq),
    length(barcodes_to_remove),
    nrow(paluseq) - nrow(paluseq_clean),
    nrow(paluseq_clean)
  )
)

# 5. Combine into a single QC object
qc_summary <- list(
  by_site = qc_by_site,
  overall = qc_overall
)

```

```{r remove non consents from seq file, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}
## REMOVE NON-CONSENTED BARCODES FROM PALUSEQ AND SEQ DF AND EXPORT TO XL## 

# Master list of non-consented barcodes
barcodes_noconsent <- all_noconsent$barcode

#see lists of what will be removed
removed_from_sequencing <- sequencing %>%
  mutate(PID_upper = toupper(PID)) %>%
  filter(PID_upper %in% barcodes_noconsent) %>%
  distinct(PID_upper)

removed_from_paluseq <- paluseq %>%   # BEFORE cleaning
  mutate(barcode_upper = toupper(barcode)) %>%
  filter(barcode_upper %in% barcodes_noconsent) %>%
  distinct(barcode_upper) #
#removed from palu df is smaller than removed from seq, because RL stopped uploading non-consented CRFs, but this was after DBS was already sent off for sequencing

# write.xlsx(removed_from_sequencing, "remove_from_sequencing.xlsx")

# write.xlsx(all_noconsent, "all_noconsent.xlsx")

#see list of barcodes only in seq
setdiff(removed_from_sequencing$PID_upper, removed_from_paluseq$barcode_upper) 

# Remove non-consented barcodes from paluseq

  mutate(barcode_upper = toupper(barcode)) %>%
  filter(!barcode_upper %in% barcodes_noconsent)

  mutate(PID_upper = toupper(PID)) %>%
  filter(!PID_upper %in% barcodes_noconsent)
```
