```{r make seq_discrep_2, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}

# Use list of PaluSeq samples sequenced to date from Chris (all have been attempted sequencing as of 1/12/26, will need demographic data around end of feb 2026 after Chris returns from Kin)

# Compare paluseq$barcode and sequencing$PID, write "Yes" if the barcode exists in both lists (data has been uploaded to sharepoint), write "No" if the barcode only exists in the sequencing list which means we are still awaiting that data to be uploaded from the SANRU team.

# create a unified list of all IDs from both sources
all_ids <- tibble(
  ID = union(sequencing$PID, paluseq$barcode)
)

# left join needed variables 
paluseq_meta <- paluseq %>%
  select(
    ID = barcode,
    Visit_date = CaseReportForm_VisitSection_VisitDate,
    Province = province,
    Health_zone = health_zone,
    Site = health_facility
  )

# classify each ID
sequencing_discrepancies_2 <- all_ids %>%
  left_join(paluseq_meta, by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      ID %in% sequencing$PID & ID %in% paluseq$barcode ~ "Données démographiques et de séquençage complètes",
      ID %in% sequencing$PID & !(ID %in% paluseq$barcode) ~ "Séquencé (en attente du téléchargement des données démographiques)",
      !(ID %in% sequencing$PID) & ID %in% paluseq$barcode ~ "Données démographiques téléchargées (en attente des données de séquençage)"
    )
  )


write.xlsx(sequencing_discrepancies_2, "sequencing_discrepancies_2.xlsx")


barcode_cols <- c(
  "CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode_String",
  "CaseReportForm_Page1Barcode",
  "CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode",
  "CaseReportForm_Page4Barcode_String"
)

target_ids <- sequencing_discrepancies_2 %>%
  filter(status == "Séquencé (en attente du téléchargement des données démographiques)") %>%
  pull(ID) %>%
  as.character()

flagged_rows <- paluseq_raw_untouched %>%
  filter(
    if_any(
      all_of(barcode_cols),
      ~ as.character(.) %in% target_ids
    )
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(barcode_cols), everything())


flagged_rows <- paluseq_raw_untouched %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    matched_ID = paste(
      unique(
        na.omit(
          c_across(all_of(barcode_cols))[
            c_across(all_of(barcode_cols)) %in% target_ids
          ]
        )
      ),
      collapse = "; "
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(matched_ID != "")
```

```{r END OF DATA CLEANING BELOW ARE FIGURES AND TABLES, echo = FALSE, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}
    # --- Mosquito nets ---
    mosquito_nets_in_house, slept_under_net_last_night, slept_under_net_last_night_t1, mosquito_net_source,

    # --- Indoor residual spraying ---

    # --- Residence in DRC ---
    main_residence_drc, main_residence_drc_t1, residence_if_not_drc, months_in_drc_past_year,

    # --- Travel in the past month ---
    traveled_out_of_village_past_month, traveled_out_of_village_past_month_t1, nights_spent_location,

    # --- Travel: location 1 ---
    ## location1_province, location1_village,  # ADDTL CLEANING NEEDED
    location1_nights,
```

```{r progress bars thermometer edit, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=4, out.width="100%"}

#alt : fig.width=14, fig.height=7

# 1) Summarize counts by status and build (n=) labels
status_summary <- sequencing_discrepancies_2 %>%
  count(status, name = "count") %>%
  mutate(
    status_label = paste0(status, " (n=", count, ")")
  )

# Total current samples
current_total <- sum(status_summary$count)

# Compute percent of goal
goal_total <- 12859
percent_of_goal <- round(current_total / goal_total * 100, 1)

# 2) Define colors for each status
status_colors <- c(
  "Données démographiques et de séquençage complètes"      = "#2ECC71",
  "Données démographiques téléchargées (en attente des données de séquençage)" = "#E67E22",
  "Séquencé (en attente du téléchargement des données démographiques)"           = "#F1C40F"
)

# 3) Build plotting data for stacked bar
plot_data <- status_summary %>%
  mutate(bar = "Progress")

# 4) Goal bar
goal_data <- tibble(
  bar   = "Progress",
  count = goal_total
)

# 5) Plot: thermometer-style stacked bar
ggplot() +
  # Outer goal bar
  geom_col(
    data = goal_data,
    aes(x = bar, y = count),
    fill = "gray85",
    width = 0.6
  ) +
  
  # Goal label at end
geom_text(
  data = goal_data,
  aes(x = bar, y = count, label = "12,859"),
  hjust = -0.1,
  size = 5,
  fontface = "bold",
  color = "gray30"
) +

  # Inner stacked progress bar
  geom_col(
    data = plot_data,
    aes(x = bar, y = count, fill = status),
    width = 0.6
  ) +

  # Percent label at end of filled portion
geom_text(
  data = tibble(
    bar = "Progress",
    count = current_total,
    label = paste0(current_total, " (", percent_of_goal, "% of goal)")
  ),
  aes(
    x = 1.4,   # make larger to move label higher above the bar
    y = count,
    label = label
  ),
  size = 5,
  fontface = "bold"
) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = status_colors,
    breaks = status_summary$status,
    labels = status_summary$status_label,
    name   = ""
  ) +
  
  #uncomment below to make custom y axis for 1859 to go on axis instead 
 # scale_y_continuous(
 # breaks = c(0, goal_total),   # 0 and 12,859
#  labels = c(
#    "0",
#    expression(bold("12,859"))
#  )
#)+


  coord_flip(clip = "off") +

  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Échantillons/Samples",
    #title    = "Progress Toward Target",
    subtitle = "État de traitement des échantillons collectés\nProcessing status of samples collected"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
     legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # smaller legend labels
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 40, 20, 10) #margin(top, right, bottom, left), large #s is more empty space on that side of the plot
  )
```

```{r enrollment targets, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}
#### Cible d'inscription et réalisation <- put back as title once included S

#Note that it filters out people with missing study period !  

# 1. Assign study_period_3 based on visit date
paluseq <- paluseq %>%
  mutate(
    study_period_3 = case_when(
      date_visit >= as.Date("2024-01-01") & date_visit < as.Date("2024-07-01") ~ "Printemps/Spring 2024",
      date_visit >= as.Date("2024-07-01") & date_visit < as.Date("2025-01-01") ~ "Automne/Fall 2024",
      date_visit >= as.Date("2025-01-01") & date_visit < as.Date("2025-07-01") ~ "Printemps/Spring 2025",
      date_visit >= as.Date("2025-07-01") & date_visit < as.Date("2026-01-01") ~ "Automne/Fall 2025",
      date_visit >= as.Date("2026-01-01") & date_visit < as.Date("2026-07-01") ~ "Printemps/Spring 2026",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    study_period_3 = factor(
      study_period_3,
      levels = c(
        "Printemps/Spring 2024",
        "Automne/Fall 2024",
        "Printemps/Spring 2025",
        "Automne/Fall 2025",
        "Printemps/Spring 2026"
      )
    )
  )

# 2. Count enrollments by province, facility, and period
enrollment_counts <- paluseq %>%
  filter(!is.na(study_period_3) & !is.na(province) & !is.na(health_facility)) %>%
  group_by(province, health_facility, study_period_3) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# 3. Pivot to wide format
enrollment_wide <- enrollment_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = study_period_3,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# 3.5 Ensure all expected columns exist
expected_periods <- c(
  "Printemps/Spring 2024",
  "Automne/Fall 2024",
  "Printemps/Spring 2025",
  "Automne/Fall 2025",
  "Printemps/Spring 2026"
)
for (period in expected_periods) {
  if (!period %in% colnames(enrollment_wide)) {
    enrollment_wide[[period]] <- 0
  }
}

# 4. Add row totals
enrollment_wide <- enrollment_wide %>%
  mutate(Total = rowSums(across(all_of(expected_periods))))

# 5. Compute grand total BEFORE adding province-level totals
grand_total <- enrollment_wide %>%
  select(-province, -health_facility) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum)) %>%
  mutate(
    province = "Toutes les provinces/All the provinces",
    health_facility = "Total"
  ) %>%
  select(province, health_facility, everything())

# 6. Add province-level totals
province_totals <- enrollment_wide %>%
  group_by(province) %>%
  summarise(across(-health_facility, sum)) %>%
  mutate(health_facility = "Total") %>%
  select(province, health_facility, everything())

# 7. Combine facility-level and province-level totals
enrollment_wide <- bind_rows(enrollment_wide, province_totals) %>%
  arrange(province, health_facility)

# 8. Only show province once per block
enrollment_wide <- enrollment_wide %>%
  group_by(province) %>%
  mutate(province = if_else(row_number() == 1, province, "")) %>%
  ungroup()

# 9. Combine with grand total
enrollment_wide_final <- bind_rows(enrollment_wide, grand_total)

# 10. Rename columns
colnames(enrollment_wide_final)[1:2] <- c("Province", "Health Facility")

# 11. Format cells with dynamic denominators and color
targets_grand <- c(
  "Printemps/Spring 2024" = 1100,
  "Automne/Fall 2024"     = 2300,
  "Printemps/Spring 2025" = 3500,
  "Automne/Fall 2025"     = 3500,
  "Printemps/Spring 2026" = 3500
)
overall_target <- sum(targets_grand)

enrollment_wide_final <- enrollment_wide_final %>%
  mutate(row_type = case_when(
    Province == "Toutes les provinces/All the provinces" ~ "grand_total",
    `Health Facility` == "Total" ~ "province_total",
    TRUE ~ "facility"
  )) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(expected_periods),
    ~ {
      val <- .x
      denom <- case_when(
        row_type == "grand_total" ~ targets_grand[cur_column()],
        row_type == "province_total" ~ 400,
        TRUE ~ 100
      )
      color <- if (val >= denom) "green" else NA
      if (!is.na(color)) {
        sprintf("<span style='color:%s'>%.1f%% (%d/%d)</span>", color, (val / denom) * 100, val, denom)
      } else {
        sprintf("%.1f%% (%d/%d)", (val / denom) * 100, val, denom)
      }
    }
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Total = if_else(row_type == "facility", as.character(Total), as.character(Total))) %>%
  select(-row_type)

# 12. Format bottom-right corner cell
grand_total_index <- nrow(enrollment_wide_final)
raw_total <- enrollment_wide %>%
  filter(health_facility != "Total") %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(Total)) %>%
  pull(Total)
grand_color <- if (raw_total >= overall_target) "green" else NA
grand_total_formatted <- if (!is.na(grand_color)) {
  sprintf("<span style='color:%s'>%.1f%% (%d/%d)</span>", grand_color, (raw_total / overall_target) * 100, raw_total, overall_target)
} else {
  sprintf("%.1f%% (%d/%d)", (raw_total / overall_target) * 100, raw_total, overall_target)
}
enrollment_wide_final$Total[grand_total_index] <- grand_total_formatted

# 13. Identify province-level total rows
province_total_rows <- which(enrollment_wide_final$`Health Facility` == "Total")
province_total_rows <- province_total_rows[-length(province_total_rows)] # exclude grand total

# 14. Create styled kable
kbl_out <- enrollment_wide_final %>%
  kbl(
    align = "lccccccc",
    caption = "Enrollments by Province, Health Facility, and Study Period (%)",
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#D3D3D3") %>%
  row_spec(province_total_rows, bold = TRUE, extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid #999;") %>%
  row_spec(nrow(enrollment_wide_final), bold = TRUE, extra_css = "border-top: 3px solid black;")

# 15. Save to HTML
save_kable(
  kbl_out,
  file = "enrollment_table.html"
)

```

```{r table1, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}


table1(
    ~ sex 
    + age_cat
    + education_cat
   # + occupation_checkbox #mult checked options
  
  | province_desc,
  data = paluseq,
  overall = c(left = "Overall")
 # caption = "<div style='text-align: left;'>Caractéristiques des participants/Participant characteristics</div>"
)
```

***

```{r table1.2, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}

#### Occupation

##### De nombreux participants exerçaient plusieurs activités professionnelles et beaucoup étaient sans emploi.
##### Many participants reported multiple occupations and many were unemployed.

occupation_counts %>%
  kable(align = "l") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  footnote(general = paste0(
    "N = ", n_occupation_respondents,
    " ont répondu à cette question/responded to this question. ",
    "Réponses multiples possibles/",
    "Multiple responses possible."
  ))


```

***
#### Le paludisme/Malaria

##### La plupart des participants ont été testés positifs par TDRM et une majorité a signalé de la fièvre ou des frissons dans les 48 heures précédant l'enrolment.
##### Most participants tested positive by RDT and a majority reported fever or chills in the 48 hours preceding enrollment.
 
```{r table2, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

table1(
    ~diagnosis_method + fever_last48hours
   # + patient_diagnosed_malaria
   # + treated_malaria_30days_t1
  | province_desc,
  data = paluseq,
  overall = c(left = "Overall")
  #caption = "<div style='text-align: left;'>Tous les participants/All participants </div>"
)
```

***

```{r table2.1, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include = FALSE}

##### Parmi les participants ayant obtenu un résultat positif, la plupart avaient été diagnostiqués par TDRM. 
##### Among participants who tested positive, most tested positive by RDT.  


## Among those diagnosed, with which method were they diagnosed? 

paluseq_diagnosed_malaria <- paluseq %>% 
  filter(patient_diagnosed_malaria == "Oui/Yes")

table1(
    ~diagnosis_method
  | province_desc,
  data = paluseq_diagnosed_malaria,
  overall = c(left = "Overall")
  #caption = "<div style='text-align: left;'>Le paludisme/Malaria: Parmi les personnes ayant un diagnostic positif/Among Positives</div>"
)
```

***
##### Parmi les participants ayant reçu un traitement antipaludique dans les 30 jours précédant l’enrolment et ayant recherché un traitement ou des conseils, la plupart se sont rendus dans une pharmacie.
##### Among participants who received malaria treatment in the 30 days preceding enrollment and sought treatment or advice, most went to a pharmacy.

```{r table3, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
##Among those treated, who said yes to sought trtmnt or counsel, where did they seek it

paluseq_sought_treatment <- paluseq %>% 
  filter(sought_treatment_t1 == "Oui/Yes")

treatment_location_counts %>%
  kable(align = "l") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  footnote(general = paste0(
    "N = ", n_treatment_location_respondents,
    " parmi ceux ayant cherché un traitement/among those who sought treatment. ",
    "Réponses multiples possibles/",
    "Multiple responses possible."
  ))
```

***
##### Médicaments pris pour le paludisme au cours des 30 jours précédant l'enrolment
##### Medications taken for malaria in the 30 days preceding enrollment
```{r table3.1, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}


## Among those treated, what were they treated with 


paluseq_malaria_meds <- paluseq %>% 
  filter(malaria_medication_taken_t1 == "Oui/Yes")

medications_taken_counts %>%
  kable(align = "l") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  footnote(general = paste0(
    "N = ", n_medications_taken_respondents,
    " ont fourni des détails sur les médicaments/provided medication details. ",
    "Réponses multiples possibles/",
    "Multiple responses possible."
  ))
```

***
##### La plupart de ceux qui ont pris des médicaments n'ont pas terminé le traitement.
##### Most who took medication did not complete treatment.
```{r table3.2, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
## meds completed among users?

 table1(
     ~completed_treatment_t1 | province_desc,
   data = paluseq_malaria_meds,
   overall = c(left = "Overall"))
  # caption = "<div style='text-align: left;'>Parmi les personnes traitées/Among the treated</div>")
 
 ## why no finish among non finishers
 
 paluseq_meds_nofinish <- paluseq %>% 
  filter(completed_treatment_t1 == "Non/No")
 
```

***
#### Résidence et déplacements / Residence and movement

##### La plupart avaient dormi sous une moustiquaire la nuit précédente ou avaient voyagé au cours du mois avant.
##### Most slept under a mosquito net the night prior or traveled in the past month.
```{r table4, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

table1(
    ~people_in_house
    + mosquito_nets_in_house
    + slept_under_net_last_night_t1
    + house_sprayed_inside_t1
    + traveled_out_of_village_past_month_t1
  | province_desc,
  data = paluseq,
  overall = c(left = "Overall")
 # caption = "<div style='text-align: left;'>Tous les participants/All participants </div>"
)
```
